**Designation:** Sr. Executive – HR, Compliance \& IR  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reporting To:** HR Manager / Head – HR  
**Location:** As per business/site requirement

Job Purpose

To manage day\-to\-day HR operations, statutory compliance, employee relations and industrial relations activities while ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws and company policies.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. HR Operations**

* Manage employee joining, onboarding, documentation and separation formalities.
* Maintain employee master data and personnel records.
* Manage attendance, leave, overtime and manpower records.
* Coordinate payroll inputs and verify salary\-related data.
* Prepare HR MIS and manpower reports.
* Coordinate with site and corporate HR teams for employee\-related matters.

**2\. Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure timely compliance under applicable labour and employment laws.
* Manage **EPF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Bonus, Gratuity** and other statutory requirements.
* Maintain statutory registers, records and employee documentation.
* Coordinate statutory returns, challans, inspections and notices.
* Ensure compliance related to contract labour and applicable labour licences.
* Maintain compliance records for audits and client requirements.
* Coordinate with consultants, government departments and statutory authorities when required.

**3\. Industrial Relations (IR)**

* Handle employee grievances and workplace issues.
* Maintain healthy employer\-employee relations.
* Support disciplinary proceedings and issue of notices as per company policy.
* Handle absenteeism, misconduct and employee disputes.
* Coordinate with workers, supervisors, contractors and management for resolving IR matters.
* Support negotiations and discussions with employees/workmen and representatives where required.
* Maintain records related to disciplinary and IR cases.

**4\. Contract Labour Management**

* Monitor contractor manpower and statutory compliance.
* Verify contractor attendance, wages and statutory documents.
* Ensure compliance related to **Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act / applicable labour codes and rules**.
* Monitor labour licence, wage records, PF/ESIC compliance, insurance and other required documents.
* Coordinate contractor compliance audits and documentation.

**5\. Audit \& Compliance Management**

* Prepare documents for internal, client and statutory audits.
* Identify compliance gaps and take corrective actions.
* Maintain compliance trackers and monthly compliance reports.
* Coordinate with different departments for closure of audit observations.

**6\. HR Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain HR registers, employee files and statutory records.
* Prepare monthly HR and compliance MIS.
* Maintain records such as attendance registers, wage registers, overtime records, leave records and employment\-related documents.
* Ensure proper documentation for client/project requirements.

Key Skills

* HR Operations
* Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance
* Industrial Relations
* Payroll \& Attendance
* Contract Labour Compliance
* Employee Grievance Handling
* HR MIS \& Reporting
* Audit \& Documentation
* MS Excel
* Communication \& Negotiation
* Problem Solving

**Experience:** 4–7 years in HR Operations, Statutory Compliance and Industrial Relations, preferably in **Engineering, EPC, O\&M, Manufacturing, Power Plant, Steel, Refinery, Mining or Manpower Services**.

Key Performance Indicators

* 100% timely statutory compliance
* Payroll and attendance accuracy

title: HR Technology & Automation Manager
description:
**Main Purpose**


The HR Technology \& Automation Manager is responsible for leading the global HR technology function, encompassing the strategic ownership, configuration, governance, continuous improvement, and roadmap evolution of Workday and the broader HR technology landscape. The role also drives HR process automation and digitalization across the organization — identifying, redesigning, and implementing automation solutions that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and enhance the employee experience.


Acting as both a strategic and technical leader, this role bridges HR, IT, HRIS, and technology vendors. It manages day\-to\-day HRIS operations, leads a team of HRIS analysts, and champions the adoption of workflow automation, AI, and digital tools across HR processes.

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

**HR Technology \& Workday**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, and continuous improvement of Workday and all HRIS functionalities across the organization, including modules, integrations, security, reporting, and enhancements.
* Manage the full lifecycle of HRIS projects: requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support for implementations, upgrades, and system integrations.
* Develop, maintain, and migrate integration solutions between Workday and internal/external systems (Payroll, Finance, Benefits, etc.) using Studio, Cloud Connect, REST/SOAP Web Services, XML, and XSLT.
* Define and enforce HRIS governance frameworks, data standards, access controls, and security configurations to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor system performance and proactively recommend improvements to optimize the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of HR systems.
* Manage the HRIS budget including planning, vendor cost management, and tracking execution against approved budgets aligned with business priorities.
* Stay current on Workday releases, community updates, and the broader HR technology market; assess the impact of new features and lead their adoption where relevant.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for all HRIS configurations, integrations, and processes.
* Provide expert guidance and training to team members and HR stakeholders on HRIS and Workday best practices.
* Serve as the key integrator between functional HR requirements and technical HRIS delivery; partner closely with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, and external vendors globally.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and company policies related to HR data security and privacy.

**HR Automation \& Process Digitalization**

* Own the HR automation agenda: systematically identify repetitive, manual, high\-volume, or error\-prone HR processes across the function as candidates for automation or digitalization.
* Partner with HR stakeholders to map, redesign, and streamline processes before automating — ensuring automation reinforces best\-practice workflows, not inefficient ones.
* Evaluate, recommend, and implement automation solutions including workflow automation tools, RPA, AI\-powered capabilities, system integrations, and digital self\-service enhancements.
* Leverage AI and intelligent automation tools where appropriate to improve HR data quality, accelerate processing, reduce manual intervention, and enable predictive insights.
* Establish governance standards, prioritization frameworks, and documentation practices for all HR automation initiatives across the organization.
* Define and track impact metrics for automation efforts: efficiency gains, reduction in manual effort, data quality improvements, error reduction, and enhanced employee and manager experience.
* Act as the bridge between HR, IT, HRIS, and technology vendors to ensure alignment on automation strategy, tooling, data security, and architecture.
* Build awareness and capability across the HR team for automated tools and self\-service solutions, driving adoption and reducing dependency on manual processing.
* Continuously scan the HR technology landscape for emerging platforms, AI\-enabled capabilities, and automation tools that can advance HR digitalization goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Human Resources, or a related field of study.
* Minimum 8 years of HRIS/HR technology experience, with at least 5 years of hands\-on Workday expertise including module configuration, integrations, and security (Studio, Cloud Connect, REST/SOAP, XML, XSLT).
* Proven track record leading HRIS teams and delivering global HR technology initiatives in a complex, multi\-country environment.
* Demonstrated experience in HR automation, process digitalization, or the implementation of workflow/RPA/AI\-enabled solutions within HR.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and data across domains such as Recruiting, Onboarding, Compensation, Payroll, Benefits, and Learning.
* Experience with Workday tenant security configuration, integration architecture design patterns, and ERP integration best practices.
* Excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, and organizational skills; comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast\-paced, agile environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to translate technical topics clearly for non\-technical HR stakeholders and present confidently at senior levels.
* Experience with software development lifecycle and project management; agile methodology experience is a plus.
* Shows initiative, works independently with minimal supervision, and approaches complex problems creatively with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Exposure to AI tools, process mining, intelligent automation platforms, or digital transformation programs is a strong plus.

This is a build\-from\-scratch HR role. The selected candidate will be responsible for establishing the HR function, putting structured processes and policies in place, and managing the complete employee lifecycle.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently, taking ownership, and building systems rather than simply executing existing HR processes.

4\. Performance Management

\* Develop KRAs/KPIs in coordination with department heads.

\* Establish performance review cycles and feedback mechanisms.

5\. Policies \& Employee Engagement

\* Create a professional and positive work culture.

7\. HR Strategy \& Reporting

\* Work closely with management to understand business and manpower requirements.

\* Develop HR strategies aligned with the company’s growth plans.

\* Create HR dashboards and regular reports covering hiring, attrition, attendance, performance and other key metrics.

\* Build a data\-driven and structured approach to people management.

What We Are Looking For

\* Proven ability to build HR systems and processes from scratch.

\* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory HR compliance.

\* Strong ownership and problem\-solving ability.

The person joining this role will have end\-to\-end ownership of HR at Radheshyam, including:

People → Policies → Processes → Recruitment → Performance → Culture → Compliance → Employee Lifecycle

This is an opportunity for an HR professional who wants to build the HR function from the ground up and create a long\-term, scalable people framework for a growing business.

description:
**PLANT MANAGER**

**Industry:** Thermistors / Electronic Components / Powder Metallurgy  
**Department:** Plant Operations  
**Reports To:** Managing Director / Operations Director  
**Location:** Nila Tech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Experience:** 12–20 years, preferably with 5\+ years in a plant leadership role

Job Purpose

The Plant Manager will be responsible for the overall management and performance of the manufacturing plant, ensuring safe, efficient, cost\-effective, and timely production of thermistors and other powder\-metallurgy\-based electronic components.

The role will lead production, process engineering, quality, maintenance, production planning, stores, utilities, safety, and manpower management while driving continuous improvement, productivity enhancement, waste reduction, and customer satisfaction.

The Plant Manager will be expected to develop a strong manufacturing culture based on process discipline, quality at source, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities1\. Plant Operations \& Production

* Take overall responsibility for day\-to\-day plant operations and manufacturing performance.
* Ensure production plans are achieved in terms of quantity, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Develop and implement production strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Monitor production capacity, bottlenecks, cycle times, OEE, productivity, and utilization.
* Ensure effective control of processes involved in powder metallurgy and thermistor manufacturing, including:
* Raw\-material preparation and powder processing
* Mixing / formulation
* Granulation and pressing
* Sintering / firing
* Grinding and sizing
* Metallization / electrode application
* Lead forming / assembly
* Electrical testing and inspection
* Packaging and final dispatch
* Establish appropriate process parameters, control plans, and standard operating procedures in coordination with engineering and quality teams.
* Improve line balancing, material flow, layout, and production efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules and minimize delays and downtime.

2\. Quality Management

* Ensure consistent product quality and compliance with customer specifications.
* Work closely with the Quality team to establish and maintain process controls.
* Drive reduction of rejection, rework, scrap, customer complaints, and process variation.
* Monitor critical characteristics such as resistance values, B\-value, tolerance, dimensional accuracy, electrical characteristics, mechanical strength, and reliability, as applicable to the product.
* Ensure effective root\-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action for internal and customer quality issues.
* Promote a zero\-defect / quality\-at\-source culture throughout the plant.
* Support customer audits, certification audits, and process/product audits.

3\. Powder Metallurgy \& Process Engineering

* Develop a strong understanding of powder metallurgy processes and their impact on product performance.
* Ensure control of critical variables such as:
* Powder composition and particle characteristics
* Mixing uniformity
* Binder/additive control
* Compaction pressure and density
* Green strength
* Sintering temperature profiles and atmosphere
* Shrinkage and dimensional control
* Electrode/metallization quality
* Electrical characteristics
* Work with R\&D / Process Engineering teams for new product introduction, process development, and process optimization.
* Lead scale\-up activities from laboratory/prototype stage to mass production.
* Ensure process capability and repeatability for critical manufacturing operations.

4\. Maintenance \& Utilities

* Ensure high availability and reliability of production equipment.
* Establish preventive and predictive maintenance systems.
* Monitor equipment downtime, MTBF, MTTR, and maintenance costs.
* Ensure timely maintenance of critical equipment such as presses, furnaces, grinders, mixers, testing equipment, compressors, HVAC systems, and utilities.
* Develop plans for machine upgrades, automation, replacement, and capacity expansion.
* Ensure adequate spare\-parts planning and inventory control.
* Improve equipment OEE and reduce unplanned breakdowns.

5\. Cost \& Productivity Improvement

* Take ownership of plant manufacturing costs and drive continuous cost reduction.
* Identify opportunities to reduce:
* Material consumption
* Scrap and rejection
* Energy consumption
* Labour cost per unit
* Machine downtime
* Consumable costs
* Conversion costs
* Establish productivity improvement targets for each department.

Job Purpose

The Strategic Manager\-cum\-Executive will work closely with the senior management team to support the company’s **strategic growth, business development, project execution, operational efficiency, and management decision\-making**.

The role requires a combination of strategic thinking and hands\-on execution. The incumbent will monitor key business activities, coordinate between departments and project teams, identify growth opportunities, ensure timely follow\-up on management decisions, and provide regular performance insights to senior management.

* Monitor achievement of business, financial, operational, and project\-related objectives.
* Identify business gaps, operational challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
* Prepare management reports, dashboards, MIS, and strategic analysis for decision\-making.
* Track industry trends, construction\-sector developments, competitors, and emerging business opportunities.

2\. Business Development \& Growth

* Identify and evaluate new business opportunities, projects, clients, and market segments.
* Support the preparation of business proposals, capability presentations, tenders, and client submissions.
* Develop and maintain relationships with clients, consultants, architects, contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the estimation and tendering teams to assess project opportunities.
* Monitor the company's project pipeline and follow up on prospective projects.
* Support senior management in negotiations and strategic business discussions.

3\. Project \& Operations Coordination

* Monitor the overall progress of ongoing construction projects against approved schedules, budgets, and milestones.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Procurement, Accounts, HR, and other departments.
* Identify delays, bottlenecks, resource constraints, and critical project issues and escalate them to management.
* Follow up on corrective actions and ensure timely closure of management decisions.
* Review project progress reports and highlight critical deviations.
* Assist in improving coordination between the corporate office and project sites.

4\. Commercial \& Financial Monitoring

* Assist management in monitoring project profitability, cost control, cash flow, and collections.
* Review project budgets and compare actual performance against planned costs.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Finance regarding billing, receivables, payments, and outstanding amounts.
* Track variations, additional works, claims, and commercial issues.
* Highlight financial risks and potential cost overruns to senior management.

5\. Procurement \& Vendor Coordination

* Coordinate with procurement teams regarding material requirements, quotations, purchase orders, and delivery schedules.
* Assist in evaluating vendors and subcontractors based on cost, quality, reliability, and delivery performance.
* Monitor critical material and subcontractor requirements for ongoing projects.
* Support management in resolving major procurement and vendor\-related issues.

6\. Management Coordination \& Executive Support

* Act as a coordination link between senior management and various departments.
* Maintain a tracker of key decisions, priorities, deadlines, and action points assigned by management.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with concerned personnel and report status to management.
* Organize management meetings and prepare agendas, minutes, and action plans where required.
* Ensure important instructions and decisions are communicated effectively and followed through.
* Handle confidential management information with professionalism and discretion.

7\. Performance Monitoring \& MIS

* Develop and maintain management dashboards covering:
* Project progress
* Revenue and collections
* Project profitability
* Tender pipeline
* Procurement status
* Manpower
* Receivables
* Critical risks and issues
* Prepare weekly and monthly management reports.
* Analyze KPIs and identify areas requiring management intervention.
* Ensure timely and accurate information is available for strategic decision\-making.

8\. Risk Management \& Problem Solving

* Identify operational, commercial, financial, contractual, and project\-related risks.
* Maintain a risk and issue tracker for critical projects and business activities.
* Recommend practical solutions to improve project and business performance.
* Escalate critical risks to senior management along with possible corrective actions.
* Support crisis management and resolution of critical operational issues.

9\. Process Improvement

* Review existing business and project processes and identify inefficiencies.
* Recommend systems, procedures, and controls to improve productivity and accountability.
* Support implementation of SOPs, reporting systems, digital tools, and performance\-monitoring mechanisms.
* Promote better coordination and communication across departments.

10\. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Support senior management in maintaining key client relationships.
* Participate in client meetings, project review meetings, negotiations, and business discussions when required.
* Ensure important client concerns are followed up and resolved promptly.
* Maintain professional relationships with consultants, government authorities, vendors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.

11\. Special Projects \& Management Initiatives

* Take ownership of strategic projects or special assignments entrusted by senior management.
* Conduct research, analysis, feasibility studies, and business assessments as required.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives involving multiple departments.

The ultimate objective is simple: Ensure ReadyAssist has the right service provider, with the right skill, at the right location, at the right time — 24×7, 365 days a year — to fulfil every eligible RSA order within SLA.

The person we are looking for: A hunter, builder and operator who can walk into a market, understand the supply gap, find the right partners, negotiate, onboard, activate them, and build a reliable 24×7 supply network. Someone who does not wait for supply problems to appear on a dashboard — they go to the ground and solve them.

Preferred Experience **5–10 years in Ground Operations, Field Operations, Mobility, Logistics, Last\-Mile Delivery, Aggregator Management, Partner Acquisition, or similar businesses.**  Minimum 3–5 years in a field leadership role managing distributed partner/aggregator networks.

**Proven experience in on\-ground partner acquisition and network expansion.**  Experience managing large and geographically distributed service\-provider ecosystems. **Experience in an on\-demand, SLA\-driven business is strongly preferred.** 

Experience in RSA, automotive, mobility, logistics, last\-mile delivery, e\-commerce, food delivery, or similar businesses will be an advantage. **Strong understanding of dashboards, operational technology, partner platforms, and data\-driven execution.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Territory Ownership **Own the complete RSA supply network within the assigned territory.**  Take end\-to\-end accountability for supply availability and order fulfilment. **Act as the single owner of supply performance for the territory.**  Build the territory into a strong, scalable, and reliable supply network. **Identify market opportunities and supply gaps proactively.**  Take complete ownership of resolving ground\-level supply challenges. 2\. Supply Network Building \& Expansion **Build and continuously expand the network of: o Aggregators o Mechanics o Towing partners o Workshops o Specialized service providers o Other relevant roadside assistance partners**  Identify underserved locations, cities, towns, highways, and pin codes.

Develop supply before business demand increases. **Maintain adequate primary and backup supply across critical locations.**  Build additional capacity for nights, weekends, holidays, peak periods, and emergencies.

3\. **Aggregator \& Partner Acquisition Personally drive partner acquisition and onboarding across the territory.**  Spend significant time in the market identifying and engaging potential aggregators and service providers. **Build strong local networks and market intelligence.**  Conduct partner meetings, capability assessments, negotiations, onboarding, and activation. **Continuously maintain a strong pipeline of prospective partners.**  Acquire the right quality and quantity of supply rather than simply increasing partner count. **Ensure every onboarded partner becomes an active and productive partner.**

4\. 24×7 Supply Availability **Ensure supply is available 24×7, 365 days a year.**  Monitor supply availability by: o Location o Pin code o Time of day o Skill type o Vehicle type o Demand pattern **Identify night\-time and low\-demand\-period supply gaps.**  Build contingency and backup supply for critical locations. **Ensure sufficient supply capacity during sudden demand spikes.**

5\. Order Fulfilment \& SLA **Own 100% order fulfilment for the territory.**  Ensure 100% order acceptance **Monitor: o Order acceptance**

o Response time o Fulfilment o SLA adherence o Cancellations o Declines o Unassigned orders o Escalations **Immediately intervene when supply shortages affect fulfilment.**  Conduct root\-cause analysis for every major supply failure. **Ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained. 6\. Skill Coverage \& Network Capability**  Ensure the territory has adequate coverage across required RSA skills. **Identify gaps in specialized services and build appropriate supply.**  Ensure the right service provider is available for the right job. **Continuously assess whether the existing network can support current and future business requirements.**  Build specialized supply wherever business requirements demand it.

7\. Partner Activation \& Productivity **Ensure onboarded partners remain active, available, and productive.**  Drive partner activation and adoption of ReadyAssist technology. **Improve order acceptance and partner productivity.**  Identify inactive, low\-performing, and unreliable partners. **Take corrective action through engagement, coaching, replacement, or network restructuring.**  Maintain strong partner relationships while enforcing operational discipline.

8\. Partner Quality \& Discipline **Ensure all partners adhere to ReadyAssist SOPs, quality standards, SLA requirements, and customer\-handling expectations.**  Conduct regular partner visits and audits. **Verify actual ground\-level availability rather than relying only on system data.**  Take action against partners demonstrating poor quality, misconduct, repeated SLA breaches, or operational indiscipline. **Maintain a high\-quality and dependable partner ecosystem.**

9\. Cost \& Commercial Discipline **Maintain healthy supply economics within the territory.**  Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising fulfilment or customer experience. **Monitor partner payout and service economics.**  Identify inefficient supply structures and redesign them where required. **Balance availability, quality, fulfilment and cost.**

10\. Extensive Field Execution **Spend a significant majority of time on the ground.**  Travel extensively across the assigned territory. **Conduct regular market visits and partner meetings.**  Personally visit critical supply\-gap locations. **Conduct surprise partner visits and operational audits.**  Meet new aggregators and service providers continuously. **Understand local market dynamics, competitor networks, pricing, availability, and partner behaviour.**  Be willing to travel anytime and anywhere when the business requires it.

11\. Data \& Performance Management **Study daily operational dashboards and identify supply gaps.**  Convert data into specific field actions. **Track territory\-level KPIs and corrective actions.**  Review partner productivity and network health regularly. **Use data to decide: o Where to onboard o Which partners to activate o Where additional supply is required o Which partners need intervention o Where supply needs to be replaced**  Provide regular performance insights to the Zonal Manager – Supply \& Network.

12\. Business Expansion Support **Build supply readiness and new business opportunities.**  Work closely with Business and Operations teams to understand upcoming demand. **Ensure the supply network is ready before business goes live.**  Scale the territory rapidly when business requirements increase.

Our founder, Deeksha Senguttuvan, spent years working in healthcare and technology, but it was her close interactions with parents that revealed the real gap in paediatric care. title: GM Service in chennai
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:\-

GENERAL MANAGER – SERVICE AT FPL GROUP

**Position**

General Manager – Service

**Company**

FPL GROUP

**Function**

After Sales – Service

**Location**

Chennai

**Team Size**

Multi\-location Service Operations

**Direct Reports**

Service Managers / Branch Heads, Workshop Managers, Parts Manager, CRM/Customer Experience Team, Body Shop / PDI Heads, as applicable

**Level**

Senior Management

The General Manager – Service will be responsible for the **overall leadership, business performance, profitability, customer experience and operational excellence of FPL GROUP after\-sales service operations across multiple locations**.

The incumbent will drive service revenue, gross profit, customer retention, workshop productivity, service quality and OEM compliance while ensuring consistent processes and customer experience across all FPL GROUP service outlets.

The role requires strong leadership of the complete after\-sales function, with a clear focus on **growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency and people development**.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. BUSINESS \& FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE

* Own the overall service business plan, revenue, gross profit and profitability for FPL GROUP.
* Develop annual operating plans, budgets and monthly business targets.
* Drive achievement of labour, parts, value\-added service and total service revenue.
* Monitor branch\-wise financial performance and take corrective action.
* Improve workshop absorption, labour utilization, technician productivity and bay utilization.
* Control operating costs without compromising customer experience or service quality.
* Review branch\-wise P\&L, expenses, manpower productivity and profitability.
* Identify new revenue opportunities and develop initiatives for service business growth.
* Conduct regular business reviews with Service Managers and branch leadership teams.

MULTI\-LOCATION SERVICE OPERATIONS

* Provide overall leadership to FPL group multiple service locations.
* Establish uniform service processes, operating standards and performance benchmarks across branches.
* Ensure optimum utilization of workshop capacity, manpower, equipment and infrastructure.
* Monitor daily workshop loading, vehicle inflow, job\-card movement, WIP and delivery performance.
* Ensure adherence to promised delivery time and minimize vehicle turnaround time.
* Drive effective appointment planning, workshop loading and customer retention.
* Ensure proper management of warranty, recall, campaign, PDI and periodic maintenance activities.
* Implement best practices across locations and replicate successful initiatives.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE \& RETENTION

* Own overall customer satisfaction, CSI/NPS and customer retention performance.
* Establish a strong customer\-first culture across all service outlets.
* Monitor customer complaints, escalations and negative feedback.
* Personally intervene in critical customer issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Drive service retention through periodic maintenance, follow\-up and customer engagement programs.
* Improve repeat repair, comeback and complaint ratios.
* Review lost customers and develop corrective action plans.
* Ensure consistent customer experience from vehicle reception through delivery and follow\-up.

OEM PROCESS COMPLIANCE

* Ensure strict adherence to OEM policies, processes and operating standards.
* Monitor OEM KPIs, audits, service quality parameters and customer satisfaction benchmarks.
* Ensure implementation of OEM service standards across all locations.
* Maintain readiness for OEM audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with warranty, technical, service campaign and recall processes.
* Coordinate with OEM regional/zonal teams on business performance and operational matters.
* Implement OEM initiatives and ensure effective communication to all concerned teams.

WORKSHOP PRODUCTIVITY \& QUALITY

* Improve technician productivity, efficiency and utilization.
* Monitor first\-time\-fix rate and reduce repeat repairs/comebacks.
* Ensure effective diagnosis, repair quality and technical escalation management.
* Improve bay utilization and workshop throughput.
* Ensure proper use of special tools, diagnostic equipment and workshop infrastructure.
* Drive 5S, housekeeping, safety and process discipline.
* Monitor quality of vehicle delivery and ensure customer concerns are completely addressed.

PARTS \& SERVICE BUSINESS

* Work closely with Parts leadership to ensure adequate parts availability and optimum inventory.
* Improve parts\-to\-labour ratio and parts gross margin.
* Reduce parts ageing, obsolescence and stock\-outs.
* Ensure timely availability of fast\-moving and critical parts.
* Drive genuine parts usage and customer\-pay parts business.
* Identify opportunities for increasing accessory, AMC, extended warranty and other value\-added service revenue.

PEOPLE LEADERSHIP \& ORGANIZATION DEVELOPMENT

* Lead, mentor and develop Service Managers and the wider after\-sales leadership team.
* Set clear individual and departmental targets.
* Conduct monthly performance reviews and capability assessments.
* Identify manpower requirements based on business volume and productivity.
* Develop succession plans for key service positions.
* Build a high\-performance culture with strong accountability and ownership.
* Ensure technical and behavioural training for technicians, service advisors and managers.
* Improve employee engagement and reduce attrition in critical positions.

H. CUSTOMER \& BUSINESS ANALYTICS

* Establish a robust MIS and performance\-review mechanism.
* Review daily, weekly and monthly service KPIs.
* Analyze branch\-wise trends in:
* Vehicle inflow
* Revenue
* Gross profit
* Labour sales
* Parts sales
* Productivity
* Efficiency
* CSI/NPS
* Retention
* Repeat repair
* Vehicle turnaround time
* Use data\-driven analysis to identify gaps and implement corrective actions.

DIGITAL \& PROCESS IMPROVEMENT

* Promote digital service appointment and customer communication initiatives.
* Improve workshop appointment conversion and utilization.
* Encourage paperless/digital processes wherever applicable.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives across service operations.
* Benchmark FPL GROUP performance against leading Hyundai dealerships and industry best practices.

SAFETY, COMPLIANCE \& GOVERNANCE

* Ensure compliance with statutory, legal, environmental and safety requirements.
* Maintain high standards of workshop safety and housekeeping.
* Ensure proper handling of hazardous materials and workshop waste.
* Ensure proper documentation, audit readiness and process governance.
* Maintain discipline in financial controls, approvals and operational procedures.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS – KPI

The Service GM will be evaluated primarily on:

**Business**

* Service Revenue
* Gross Profit / Gross Margin
* P\&L Performance
* Labour Revenue
* Parts Revenue
* Revenue per RO / Vehicle

**Operations**

* Vehicle Inflow
* Workshop Productivity
* Technician Efficiency
* Technician Utilization
* Bay Utilization
* Vehicle Turnaround Time
* First\-Time Fix Rate
* Repeat Repair / Comeback %

**Customer**

* CSI / NPS
* Customer Retention
* Service Retention %
* Complaint Closure
* Customer Escalations
* Lost Customer Recovery

**People**

* Employee Productivity
* Training \& Certification
* Attrition
* Manpower Utilization
* Employee Engagement

**OEM / Process**

* OEM KPI Achievement
* OEM Audit Score
* Warranty Performance
* Campaign / Recall Completion
* Process Compliance

QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE

* Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Automobile, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent qualification.
* **12–18 years of experience in automobile after\-sales/service operations**.
* Minimum **5–8 years in a senior Service Manager / Regional Service Manager / GM\-Service / Head of Service role**.

title: Purchase & Store Manager
description:
Job description:

The Senior Store Officer will be responsible for managing and controlling all Store operations, including receipt, inspection, storage, inventory control, material issuance, stock verification, and documentation. The role requires ensuring the availability of materials while maintaining accurate inventory records and efficient Store operations.

Qualification

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

Experience

* Minimum **7–8 years of experience** in Store Operations or Store Management.
* Experience in the **manufacturing sector** will be preferred.
* Experience in handling inventory management systems and ERP software is an advantage.

Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Inventory Management

* Receive incoming materials, equipment, and supplies and verify them against purchase orders, invoices, and delivery challans.
* Conduct inspection and ensure the quantity and condition of received materials are accurate.
* Maintain proper records of all inward and outward material movements.
* Ensure systematic storage, categorization, labelling, and identification of materials.
* Maintain accurate stock records using manual registers and/or ERP systems.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment of required materials.
* Conduct regular cycle counts and physical stock verification.
* Identify discrepancies in inventory and take necessary corrective action.
* Track material transfers and movement to and from the university.
* Monitor slow\-moving, non\-moving, damaged, and obsolete inventory.

2\. Store Operations

* Manage and supervise the day\-to\-day operations of the Store.
* Supervise Store staff and allocate daily responsibilities.
* Ensure timely issuance of materials to various departments.
* Maintain proper documentation for material receipt, issue, return, transfer, and disposal.
* Ensure safe handling, loading, unloading, and storage of materials.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and secure Store environment.
* Ensure compliance with established Store procedures and safety standards.

3\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of stock, material transactions, and inventory movements.
* Prepare periodic inventory and stock reports for management.
* Coordinate with the Purchase, Finance, Maintenance, and other concerned departments.
* Support internal and external audits by providing required inventory records and documentation.
* Ensure all Store\-related documents are properly maintained and filed.

4\. Team Management

* Guide and supervise Store Assistants and other Store staff.
* Ensure work is completed efficiently and within timelines.
* Monitor adherence to Store procedures and operational requirements.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Knowledge of Store and Inventory Management.
* Experience in material handling and stock control.
* Knowledge of ERP and inventory management systems.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office.
* Knowledge of stock auditing and physical verification.
* Documentation and record management skills.
* Team supervision and coordination skills.
* Knowledge of safety procedures related to Store operations.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidate with 7–8 years of relevant Store Management experience.
* Experience in a manufacturing organization is preferred.
* Ability to manage inventory, Store operations, documentation, and staff independently.

description:
Key Responsibilities1\. Internal Audit Planning \& Execution

* Develop and execute risk\-based internal audit plans covering academic and non\-academic departments.
* Conduct audits of finance, admissions, examinations, procurement, HR, payroll, student services, hostel, transport, stores, and other university functions.
* Review processes, policies, controls, approvals, and supporting documentation.
* Perform transaction testing and verify compliance with approved policies and procedures.
* Identify control weaknesses, process gaps, financial irregularities, and operational risks.

2\. Academic \& University Process Audit

* Review academic processes including admissions, fee collection, scholarships, attendance, examinations, results, and student records.
* Audit compliance with University policies and applicable regulatory/statutory requirements.
* Review faculty\-related processes such as recruitment, workload, attendance, leaves, and academic documentation.
* Evaluate controls around research grants, projects, consultancy, and other academic activities where applicable.

3\. Financial \& Operational Audit

* Review financial transactions, expenditure, revenue, receivables, payments, and reconciliations.
* Examine procurement, vendor selection, purchase orders, contracts, inventory, and asset management processes.
* Review payroll, employee reimbursements, advances, and other employee\-related financial transactions.
* Assess operational efficiency and identify opportunities for cost optimization.

4\. Risk \& Compliance

* Identify and assess financial, operational, academic, and compliance risks.
* Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls.
* Monitor compliance with University policies, statutory requirements, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* Support management in developing risk mitigation and control improvement measures.

5\. Audit Reporting \& Follow\-up

* Prepare detailed internal audit reports highlighting observations, risks, root causes, and recommendations.
* Discuss audit findings with concerned department heads and obtain management responses.
* Maintain an audit observation tracker and monitor closure of corrective actions.
* Conduct follow\-up audits to verify implementation of agreed recommendations.
* Escalate significant or recurring control issues to senior management.

6\. Investigation \& Special Audits

* Conduct special audits and investigations as assigned by senior management.
* Review suspected financial irregularities, policy violations, process deviations, and control failures.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper documentation of audit evidence and findings.

7\. Team \& Stakeholder Management

* Allocate audit assignments and monitor completion within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with Finance, HR, Academics, Admissions, Procurement, Examination, IT, and other departments.
* Provide guidance and training to audit team members on audit procedures, risk assessment, and internal controls.

* Master's degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, or Management will be preferred.
* **CA/CPA/CMA/CIA** or relevant professional certification will be an advantage.

Job Overview

We are seeking a dynamic, highly knowledgeable, and results\-driven **HR Specialist** to take ownership of our human resources operations. * **Soft Skills:** Exceptional emotional intelligence, stellar conflict\-resolution skills, and absolute confidentiality.

title: Onsite Recruitment Consultant
description:
\*About the Position\*

HyreSpot is looking for a proactive and energetic Field Recruiter to expand our candidate network and support our growing recruitment operations.

This is a field\-oriented recruitment position for someone who enjoys meeting people, developing contacts, identifying potential candidates, and converting hiring opportunities into successful joins.

The person in this role will work closely with the HR and Talent Acquisition team while independently exploring candidate sources such as local communities, colleges, training institutes, job fairs, referrals, job portals, and social media.

If you are confident speaking with people, enjoy networking, and are motivated by targets, this could be a good opportunity to build your career with HyreSpot.

\*Key Responsibilities\*

\* Identify and attract suitable candidates through field visits, referrals, online platforms, educational institutions, training centres, and local professional networks.

\* Meet candidates personally to understand their qualifications, experience, career interests, availability, and preferred job opportunities.

\* Conduct preliminary screening and shortlist candidates based on the requirements provided by the recruitment team.

\* Organize and participate in walk\-in interviews, recruitment campaigns, hiring drives, job fairs, and other talent acquisition activities.

\* Coordinate candidate interviews with the internal recruitment team and ensure candidates receive timely information about the process.

\* Maintain regular follow\-ups with shortlisted candidates and support them through documentation, selection, and joining.

\* Develop candidate networks within the assigned territory and continuously identify new sources for quality applicants.

\* Establish professional relationships with colleges, training institutes, placement centres, local organizations, and other talent pools.

\* Introduce candidates to HyreSpot's career opportunities and communicate job information clearly and professionally.

\* Assist the HR team in local employer\-branding and candidate\-engagement activities.

\* Monitor recruitment activity within the assigned area and identify effective methods for attracting candidates.

\* Share candidate feedback and local market information, including availability of talent and hiring trends, with the HR team.

\* Maintain accurate candidate details and ensure recruitment records are updated on time.

\* Submit daily and weekly activity reports covering sourcing, calls, meetings, interviews, selections, and joining status.

\* Work towards assigned recruitment targets and contribute to the team's overall hiring performance.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from:

\* Fresh graduates interested in building a career in recruitment or HR.

\* Candidates with up to 3 years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience.

\* Professionals from field sales, business development, customer service, telecalling, or other people\-oriented roles who want to move into recruitment.

Candidates with strong local networks and excellent communication skills.

A degree in any discipline is acceptable. An HR, Business Administration, or related qualification will be an added advantage.

\*What We Are Looking For\*

Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

Confidence in approaching and speaking with new people.

Strong networking and relationship\-building ability.

Good follow\-up discipline.

A result\-oriented approach towards assigned targets.

Ability to manage recruitment activities independently.

Comfortable travelling within the assigned territory.

Basic knowledge of computers, email, spreadsheets, and online recruitment platforms.

Knowledge of the local language will be an advantage.

Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Experience That Will Help

Prior exposure to any of the following will be useful:

However, freshers with the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to work in the field are encouraged to apply.

Compensation \& Benefits

Salary: ₹16,000 – ₹24,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and interview performance.

Additional Benefits:

Performance\-based recruitment incentives.

Travel allowance/reimbursement as per company policy.

Recruitment and talent acquisition training.

Practical exposure to multiple hiring channels.

Opportunity to develop a strong professional network.

Career progression opportunities within HR and Talent Acquisition.

Recognition for achieving recruitment and joining targets.

Career Opportunity

This role can provide a strong starting point for candidates who want to develop a long\-term career in Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Staffing, or Business Development.

High\-performing employees may be considered for increased responsibilities and future career progression within the organization based on performance, consistency, and business requirements.

Apply Now

If you enjoy meeting people, building connections, finding talent, and working towards measurable goals, HyreSpot would like to hear from you.

Join us and become part of a growing recruitment team focused on connecting candidates with meaningful career opportunities.

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹24,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

We are looking for an energetic and proactive **Business Development Intern** who is interested in B2B sales, client interaction, SaaS products, and field\-based business development.

This is a **3\-month, on\-site and field\-based internship**. The candidate will be required to travel to prospective client locations, interact with decision\-makers, demonstrate our SaaS product, and support the complete client acquisition process.

Based on performance during the internship, the candidate will have the opportunity to transition into a **full\-time Business Development Executive (BDE)** role.

Position Details

**Role:** Business Development Intern – SaaS  
**Internship Duration:** 3 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹7,000 per month \+ Travel Allowance  
**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM  
**Work Mode:** On\-Site / Field Work  
**Full\-Time Opportunity:** Performance\-based conversion to Business Development Executive after 3 months

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and approach potential clients for our SaaS product.
* Conduct regular **field visits to prospective client locations**.
* Meet business owners, managers, and key decision\-makers.
* Understand the client's existing workflow, challenges, and requirements.
* Explain and demonstrate the SaaS product, including its features, benefits, and business value.
* Conduct product demonstrations and presentations at client locations.
* Generate leads through **field outreach, cold outreach, referrals, networking, and direct prospecting**.
* Regularly follow up with interested prospects and work towards converting them into customers.
* Handle the business development cycle from **prospecting → client visit → product demo → follow\-up → conversion → onboarding**.
* Maintain proper records of leads, client meetings, follow\-ups, feedback, and conversions.
* Collect market and customer feedback and communicate insights to the internal product and management teams.
* Attend relevant networking events, exhibitions, industry events, and business meetups when required.

Field Work \& Travel

This is **not a remote or work\-from\-home internship**.

The intern will primarily be working **on the field between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM**, visiting prospective clients and conducting meetings and product demonstrations.

Candidates must be comfortable with:

* Travelling regularly to different client locations.
* Meeting and interacting with new people every day.
* Conducting face\-to\-face sales conversations.
* Demonstrating the product at client locations.
* Planning daily client visits and follow\-ups.
* Working independently while on the field.

**Official travel expenses for assigned client visits will be covered through a Travel Allowance in addition to the ₹7,000 monthly stipend.**

Skills \& Requirements

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence in approaching and speaking with potential clients.
* Good presentation, negotiation, and convincing skills.
* Interest in **Business Development, B2B Sales, SaaS, and Technology**.
* Ability to understand a SaaS product and explain it in simple business terms.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable with field\-based work.
* Willingness to travel regularly for client meetings.
* Basic knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets or CRM tools is an advantage.
* Freshers and final\-year students interested in building a career in **Business Development and SaaS Sales** can apply.

Career Opportunity

The first **3 months will serve as an internship and performance evaluation period**.

Candidates who demonstrate strong performance in **client outreach, meetings, product demonstrations, lead generation, follow\-ups, conversions, communication, and overall ownership** will be considered for conversion into a **full\-time Business Development Executive role**.

We are looking for someone who enjoys being **on the ground, meeting clients, understanding their problems, presenting solutions, and actively contributing to business growth.**

Hiring at HexCoded is not a support function — it’s a production line, and you’ll run it with AI tools, not spreadsheets alone. We screen hundreds of applicants per role across creative and business hiring, and we expect you to automate the repetitive half of that. You may not have used a terminal, an API, or an ATS before — what matters is that you can figure it out within the hour, and that you’re great with people.

* **Offers and onboarding.** Documents, first\-day setup, and a smooth candidate experience throughout.
* **Build talent pools.** Colleges, creator platforms, GitHub, communities we can hire from repeatedly.
* **Report.** A simple weekly hiring dashboard: openings, funnel numbers, time\-to\-close.

### **What you'll bring**

* **You figure things out.** Google it, ask an AI, have it working within the hour. This matters more than any skill on the list.
* **Comfortable in a terminal and on GitHub** — you’ve made an API call and know what MCP is, or can find out today. We use Claude Code daily.
* **Great on the phone and in writing.** You’ll be the first human a candidate talks to, and you can pitch a role and lock a slot in one call.
* **Extremely organised.** Multiple open roles, hundreds of candidates, zero dropped threads.
* English, written and spoken. Google Sheets. Basic Python is a plus.
* Bonus: prior recruiting or HR exposure, any ATS, or anything you’ve built and shipped.

title: HR Specialist - Operations
description:
###### **About EG:**

***At EG, we build software that makes a difference.***


Our industry\-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.


Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. We are a thriving global workforce of 3000\+ employees, with a 800\+ strong team based in Mangaluru, India.


If you are ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you will thrive here. You will be trusted to grow your skills, shape meaningful solutions, and make an impact together with talented colleagues across borders.

**About the team:**  

  

We manage end\-to\-end HR operational tasks globally, with our offices spanning across Europe and India. Our responsibilities cover all internal HR transactions within the organization, ensuring smooth execution and compliance across various processes, contributing significantly to the organization's efficiency and maintaining compliance.

*We are looking for a HR Specialist with 3 to 5 years of experience to be based at our Mangalore office in India and to be part of our growth story.*


As aHR Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes across multiple countries. You will manage HR transactions and service requests through ServiceNow, maintain data accuracy in HR systems, and provide timely and compliant support to employees and managers. This role requires a strong focus on operational excellence, confidentiality, and a service\-oriented mindset.

###### **Responsibilities:**

* **Case Management \& Support**: Respond to global HR inquiries from employees and managers via ServiceNow. Monitor and manage service ticket queues and ensure timely resolution of cases
* **Employee Lifecycle Transactions**: Handle pre\-boarding formalities, onboarding, offboarding, job changes, and transfers. Maintain employee files (virtual and hardcopy) and track pending documents. Coordinate induction sessions for new joiners and interns. Enter, validate, or approve employee data updates in the HR system.
* **HR Documentation \& Compliance**: Create and issue legal and official employee documents such as offer letters, employment certificates, NDAs, and other formal communications. Maintain proper documentation and ensure secure archiving of employee records.
* **Employee Support \& Engagement Administration**: Conduct background and ex\-employment verification checks, process joining bonuses, and maintain the employee referral tracker. Support VF2 visa applications for India\-based employees travelling to Denmark, and assist with engagement activities such as onboarding kits and recognition programs.
* **Data Management \& Reporting**: Perform regular audits and data quality checks to ensure system accuracy and compliance. Prepare routine HR reports (e.g. joiner/leaver lists, recruitment trackers) for HRBPs and payroll. Proactively resolve discrepancies and improve data integrity across systems.
* **Learning Management system:** Assist in the coordination and system updates of training and development program. Ensure employee learning records are accurately reflected and reported.

###### **Must have Skills and Experience:**

* 3\-5 years of experience in core HR operations.
* Working proficiency in written and spoken English, comfortable communicating with colleagues across countries.
* Experience interacting with global stakeholders and supporting international HR operations.
* Exposure to or hands\-on experience with HRMS tools such as **Talentsoft**, **Workday**, **Oracle**, or similar.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel** and **Word**.
* Experience in employee lifecycle management.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing processes and technologies.

###### **Good to Have:**

* Familiarity with **ServiceNow** or a similar case/ticketing system.
* Experience creating or maintaining HR process documentation.
* Familiarity with generating HR reports (e.g., headcount, attrition).
* Knowledge of HR legal and compliance requirements.
* Exposure to internal and external HR audits.

###### **What you can expect from us:**

* Real ownership — Responsibility from day one, freedom to shape your role.
* Continuous growth — Space, support and opportunities to take on new challenges.
* Collaborative culture — Global team rooted in Nordic values.
* Learning \& Development — Access to EG Academy, LinkedIn Learning, mentorship, and continuous feedback.

###### **Our Values:**

* Lead the Industry \- We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry
* Make it Happen \- We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact
* Stronger Together \- We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.


Join us in creating software that works for people, not software that makes people work


Curious what it's really like to work at EG?


Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


**About Skypoint**


Skypoint is a HITRUST r2–certified Agentic AI platform for healthcare operations, designed to accelerate productivity and operational efficiency across healthcare organizations. Our platform enables healthcare providers, payers, and senior care organizations to unify fragmented data, model industry\-specific ontologies, and deploy AI agents that automate workflows and support better, faster decision\-making.


Founded in 2020 in Portland, Oregon, Skypoint has grown to a team of over 75 employees and now serves more than 100 customers. We are proud to be recognized on Deloitte’s 2024 and 2025 Technology Fast 500™, celebrating the fastest\-growing technology companies in North America, and to be featured on the INC. 5000 list in 2025, reflecting our strong and sustained revenue growth over the past three years.


**Location:** Bengaluru \- Global Technology Park, Bellandur (Work from office \- No Hybrid/ No Remote)


**About the Role**


We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented HR Intern to support end\-to\-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, HRIS management, payroll inputs, compliance training coordination, employee engagement, and office administration. This is a hands\-on role requiring strong ownership, accuracy, and timely follow\-through.


**Key Responsibilities**


1\. Recruitment \& Hiring


* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment coordination, including candidate sourcing, screening support, interview scheduling, and follow\-ups.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate records in the ATS.
* Ensure interview feedback is completed by interviewers on time.
* Coordinate candidate documentation and pre\-joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular hiring updates.

2\. Onboarding \& Background Verification


* Coordinate the complete onboarding process for new employees.
* Collect and verify joining documentation.
* Initiate and track Background Verification (BGV) and follow up until completion.
* Ensure new hires have a smooth and well\-coordinated onboarding experience.

3\. HRIS \& Employee Data Management


* Maintain accurate and timely employee records in the HRIS/Employee Master.
* Update new hires, employee changes, exits, and other employee lifecycle information.
* Ensure HR data is complete, accurate, and readily available for reporting.

4\. Payroll \& Compliance Training Coordination


* Prepare and maintain accurate monthly payroll input data, including attendance, leave, reimbursements, deductions, and employee changes.
* Validate payroll information before submission.
* Ensure all mandatory trainings are assigned to new joiners on time.
* Track training completion and proactively follow up with employees to ensure compliance within required timelines.

5\. Employee Engagement


* Support employee engagement initiatives, celebrations, surveys, team activities, and internal events.
* Assist with employee communication and coordination.

6\. Office Administration


* Support day\-to\-day office administration and ensure a smooth workplace experience.
* Ensure office supplies, snacks, and other employee amenities are adequately maintained.
* Coordinate with vendors, facility teams, and the Tech Park management for office\-related requirements.
* Follow up proactively on facility issues and ensure timely resolution.

**Candidate Profile**


* MBA/PGDM/BBA or graduate specializing in HR/People Management.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Comfortable working with ATS, HRIS, Excel/Google Sheets, and other HR systems.
* Strong follow\-up and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* High level of ownership, accountability, and urgency.
* Proactive and comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.

What we value most: Someone who does not wait for repeated reminders—takes ownership, follows through, keeps HR data accurate, and ensures assigned activities are completed on time.


**What We Offer**


* A paid internship with competitive stipend.
* Certification post completion of internship.
* Opportunity to work on live projects with industry experts.
* Skill development, mentorship, and career growth guidance.

**Life at Skypoint**


Life at Skypoint is vibrant and forward\-thinking, focused on harnessing the power of AI and advanced technologies to innovate and solve real\-world challenges. Our culture thrives on creativity, strategic thinking, and a commitment to excellence, offering a collaborative environment where every contribution is valued.


We are dedicated to fostering personal and professional growth, ensuring team members have opportunities for advancement through continuous training and a flexible work\-life balance. Skypoint offers competitive benefits, including comprehensive health insurance and retirement plans.


***Skypoint is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic***

About Dharma Life

Dharma Life is a social enterprise working towards creating sustainable livelihoods and driving positive social impact through rural communities across India.

Role Overview

We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated **HR Intern – Talent Acquisition** to join our HR team. This is a great opportunity for freshers who want to build practical experience in **recruitment, candidate sourcing, screening, and HR coordination**.

* Source candidates through **Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms**.

Requirements

* Graduate or pursuing graduation in **BBA, B.Com, MBA (HR), or a related field**.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Good **verbal and written communication skills**.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* Comfortable making calls and communicating with candidates.
* Good interpersonal and coordination skills.
* Willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Prior internship or recruitment experience is a plus but **not mandatory**.

What You Will Learn

* End\-to\-end **Talent Acquisition process**
* Candidate sourcing and recruitment portals
* Resume screening and telephonic interviews
* Interview coordination and candidate management
* Recruitment trackers and HR databases
* Practical exposure to corporate HR operations

Who Should Apply?

This role is ideal for **freshers looking to start their career in HR/Talent Acquisition** and gain hands\-on experience in recruitment.

description:
**Recruitment Coordinator (Independent Contractor) \- Rate: $4 to $6/hr, based on experience**

  



Scale the clinical teams behind one of New York's fastest\-growing, AI\-powered multispecialty practices. Nao Medical is hiring a Healthcare Recruiter to own full\-cycle hiring across provider, behavioral health, and operations roles spanning 12\+ clinic sites in NYC and Long Island.

  


**About Nao Medical**



Nao Medical is a physician\-led, multispecialty practice delivering exceptional, affordable care across primary care, urgent care, occupational health, mental health, and nutrition. Our proprietary AI\-first operating model streamlines clinician workflows so providers can focus on what matters: their patients. Over 13 years, we've served more than a million New Yorkers, and we're building toward becoming a top national player with expansion across the United States.

  


**What You'll Do**


* **Full\-Cycle Recruitment:** Own sourcing, screening, interviews, and offer execution for provider roles (Physicians, NPs, PAs, PMHNPs) and key onshore clinical and operations positions
* **Pipeline Building:** Proactively develop and maintain a strong candidate pipeline using job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, outbound outreach, and association career centers across competitive healthcare markets
* **Hiring Manager Partnership:** Collaborate directly with clinical leadership to define role requirements, align on candidate profiles, coordinate interview scheduling, and drive timely hiring decisions
* **Process and Data Integrity:** Maintain accurate records in the ATS (UKG Ready), track pipeline metrics, and identify opportunities to improve recruitment workflows and candidate experience
* **Employer Brand and Candidate Experience:** Craft compelling job postings, deliver a warm and professional candidate journey from first contact through onboarding handoff, and represent Nao Medical's culture at every touchpoint

  


**Why You'll Love This Role**


* **High ownership, low bureaucracy.** You run recruitment end to end, with direct access to leadership and decision\-makers who move fast
* **Meaningful impact at scale.** Every provider you place expands access to affordable, stigma\-free care for underserved communities across New York
* **AI\-powered tools, less admin.** Nao's tech\-forward environment means smarter sourcing, streamlined workflows, and more time spent on the human side of recruiting
* **Growth trajectory.** Gain deep exposure to multi\-site healthcare hiring, credentialing pipelines, and workforce strategy as the organization scales nationally
* **Supportive, collaborative team.** Work alongside a people\-first HR and operations group that values initiative, accountability, and continuous improvement

  


**What You Bring**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* At least 1 year of experience in healthcare recruitment or talent acquisition
* Proven experience recruiting for provider roles (Physicians, Nurse Practitioners, Physician Assistants) is strongly preferred
* Strong sourcing skills with the ability to identify high\-quality candidates in competitive clinical markets
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a warm, professional candidate\-facing presence
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple open roles simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Familiarity with UKG Ready or similar ATS/HRIS platforms is a plus

  


**Engagement Details**


* **Type:** Independent Contractor
* **Rate:** $4 to $6/hr, based on experience
* **Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, including holidays
* **Location:** Fully remote (any location, must work EST hours)

  


**Technical Requirements**


* Reliable wired internet connection (100 Mbps minimum)
* Computer or laptop with Intel Core i5 / Ryzen 5 processor, 8GB RAM minimum, and 128GB free storage
* Dual\-screen setup preferred
* Windows 10 or macOS (latest version)
* Clear webcam (1080p or higher) and microphone
* Backup systems for electricity and internet outages

  



Nao Medical is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment.

  



Experience the Nao Medical difference. Join us in transforming healthcare, Nao!

 \& Statutory Compliance, Performance Management, Payroll \& HR Operations, Employee Relations, and People
   

  

 Belonging/Culture. The incumbent will build people processes that support plant operations, ensure a compliant and
   

  

 safe workplace, and develop organizational capability across shifts and employee categories.
   

  

 Talent Acquisition, Manpower Hiring \& Succession Planning
   

  

 Recruitment Strategy \& Workforce Planning
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end talent acquisition for the plant, acting as the primary driver of hiring strategy, execution, and


 quality of hire across blue\-collar and white\-collar categories.
   

  

* Define role requirements, job descriptions, and competency/skill profiles in collaboration with hiring managers


 and department heads.
   

  

* Build and continuously refine the recruitment strategy — build vs. buy, lateral vs. campus, contract vs.


 permanent — based on role criticality and market availability.

 sanctioned strength vs. actual, and seasonal/peak\-season hiring for plant operations.

 candidates against specific job requirements rather than pedigree alone.

 hiring.
