title: Scrum Master Senior Analyst - Cigna Healthcare
description:
**Job Role:** 
 Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
   

  

**About Cigna**
 Cigna is a global health insurance company, dedicated to its mission of helping improve the health, well\-being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making health care simple, affordable, and predictable.
   

  

 Together with colleagues located across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, and India, you will support Cigna's International Health business. As part of Cigna Healthcare, International Health provides global and local health insurance solutions for internationally mobile individuals, multinational organizations, government entities, IGOs, NGOs, and local customers worldwide.
   

  

 We are going through a global Agile transformation. As a result, we are expanding our teams and are looking for experienced Scrum Masters / Agile Team Coaches to join our team.
   

  

 Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The purpose of the Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach role is to maximize value delivery through collaboration, impediment removal, visibility, learning, and evidence\-based improvement.
   

  

 This role supports high\-performing team dynamics, sustainable delivery, continuous flow, and self\-managed teams that are shaping and maturing Agile ways of working across International Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach is a team coach and servant leader who facilitates change through the adoption and application of Agile principles, practices, and frameworks.
   

  

 The role enables teams to self\-organize, improve flow, embrace effective ways of working, and consistently deliver value outcomes to stakeholders. The role partners closely with Product Owners, team members, Release Train Engineers, Agile Product Managers, and other stakeholders to support predictable delivery and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This is a Band 3 Contributor Career Track Role.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Team Coaching and Agile Enablement
   

  

* Provide coaching and guidance to Agile Teams and support the adoption and application of Agile values, principles, and practices.
* Act as a servant leader, facilitator, mentor, and coach for individuals and teams.
* Enable teams to improve collaboration, transparency, psychological safety, accountability, and self\-management.
* Use effective communication and listening skills to teach, coach, mentor, and support healthy team interactions.
* Foster a healthy working culture, build strong relationships, and strengthen key interactions across teams and stakeholders.


 Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Support teams in improving flow, reducing bottlenecks, managing impediments, and operating at a sustainable pace.
* Help teams establish realistic and achievable delivery commitments based on capacity, clarity, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Maintain metrics and data necessary to provide visibility into maturity, progress, quality, flow, predictability, and value delivery.
* Facilitate evidence\-based improvement through retrospectives, improvement actions, and follow\-through on agreed outcomes.
* Encourage Built\-In Quality, continuous learning, and relentless improvement as part of day\-to\-day team working practices.


 Facilitation and Cadence Events
   

  

* Support and facilitate team ceremonies and cadence events that drive progress toward value delivery and business outcomes.
* Facilitate team events such as planning, team syncs, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and improvement workshops, as applicable to the team context.
* Participate in Sync events, Scrum Master / Team Coach forums, and internal Agile communities of practice.
* Support ART\-level alignment events, including PI Planning, ART Sync, Coach Sync, System Demo, and Inspect \& Adapt, as applicable.


 ART Alignment, Dependencies, and Impediments
   

  

* Provide support that helps Agile Teams improve overall ART performance through collaboration and alignment between team objectives, vision, and strategic themes.
* Facilitate and support dependency management to ensure alignment of delivery across teams.
* Support removal of impediments that hinder achievement of team goals and objectives.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruptions and external distractions while escalating systemic impediments in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, RTEs, Agile Product Managers, business stakeholders, and technology partners to maintain transparency and alignment.


 Success in this Role
   

  

* Teams demonstrate stronger self\-management, collaboration, and ownership of delivery outcomes.
* Impediments, blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks are made visible and addressed promptly.
* Team ceremonies and cadence events are purposeful, outcome\-focused, and continuously improved.
* Metrics and qualitative insights are used to improve flow, predictability, quality, and stakeholder transparency.
* Teams operate at a sustainable pace while maintaining alignment with ART priorities and International Health business outcomes.
* Continuous improvement becomes embedded in the team culture.


**Required Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Advanced Scrum Master, Professional Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* At least 4 years of proven experience as a Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach role.
* Experience facilitating team development and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Lean\-Agile principles, Scrum practices, Kanban practices, and team\-level Agile delivery.
* Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and understanding of its principles and practices.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, coaching, mentoring, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage priorities in a changing environment and support teams working under delivery deadlines.
* Ability to interact with Subject matter experts, Product Owners, Agile Product Managers, and stakeholders in a matrix structure.
* Knowledge of IT concepts, software delivery lifecycle, delivery methodologies, architecture considerations, and technical standards.


**Desired Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
* Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Mural, or similar collaboration tools.
* Experience supporting product, platform, operational, or service\-based delivery teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change and Agile transformation initiatives.
* Experience in software development lifecycle, IT delivery, product delivery, or project management.


**About The Cigna Group**
 Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: UX Designer
description:
*Practice by Numbers (PBN) \| Gurugram, India Scope: Product Design — Web App, Mobile \& Kiosk*
**About Practice By Numbers**
 Practice by Numbers is a dental practice management SaaS platform serving over 1,500 practices across North America — practice management software, VOIP, payment processing, analytics, and AI\-powered patient communication. Our users are dentists, front\-desk staff and office managers who live inside our product all day, under time pressure.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a UX Designer to own end\-to\-end product design — from problem framing and user flows through to high\-fidelity UI and developer handoff. This is a hands\-on IC role on a small design team: you will be the design presence in Gurugram, working directly with Product Managers and engineers here, and reporting to our Senior Designer in the US.
   

  

 You'll design across the platform: the AI Receptionist (voice and SMS patient conversations), Online Appointment Booking, Campaigns, Payments, PracticeIQ analytics, the new web app layout experience, and our mobile and front\-desk kiosk apps. Real workflows, real constraints — multi\-tenant software, dense data screens, and staff who need to complete a task in seconds, not minutes.
   

  

 Reports to: Senior Designer (US\-based)
   

  

 Location: Gurugram, India — this role is open in Gurugram only
   

  

 Work Mode: In\-office
   

  

 Working Hours: Primarily IST (10 AM – 5 PM), with some evening overlap with US teams (until 9–11 PM IST) as needed
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Design**
* Turn product requirements and user problems into flows, information architecture, wireframes and high\-fidelity UI in Figma
* Design for web, responsive web, mobile and kiosk — including empty, loading, error and permission states
* Prototype interactions to test and communicate intent before engineering builds it
* Design for existing screens as often as new ones — redesigns and incremental improvements are a large part of the work


**Discovery \& Validation**
* Talk to internal stakeholders (CX, support, sales) and end users to understand the workflow before designing it
* Run lightweight usability tests and design reviews; use findings to change the design, not to justify it
* Use product analytics and support tickets as inputs to design decisions


**System \& Handoff**
* Work within and contribute to our design system — components, patterns, tokens; flag and resolve inconsistencies
* Produce clear specs and handoff: states, responsive behaviour, edge cases, interaction details
* Review the built implementation against the design and close the gaps with engineering
* Apply accessibility fundamentals — contrast, hierarchy, keyboard and touch targets
* Use AI design tools alongwith legacy tools such as Figma, XD to get the designs implementation ready.


**Collaboration**
* Partner with Product Management from problem statement onward, surfacing edge cases early
* Participate in grooming, sprint planning and product reviews with distributed teams
* Present and defend design decisions with reasoning, and take critique from the Senior Designer and PMs well


**Experience**
**Required Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of core UX design experience at an internet or software product company (B2B/B2C SaaS, consumer internet, or product\-led platforms)
* A portfolio you can walk us through — 2–3 case studies showing the problem, your process, the decisions you made, and the shipped outcome. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
* Experience designing products that shipped and that you saw through to release


**Skills**
* Strong command of Figma — components, variants, auto layout, prototyping, shared libraries
* Interaction design and information architecture fundamentals: hierarchy, layout, typography, states
* Ability to design within an existing design system rather than inventing per screen
* Comfortable designing data\-dense screens — tables, dashboards, filters, settings
* Clear written and verbal English; can explain a design decision to a US stakeholder without a meeting


**Attributes**
* Comfort with ambiguity — you can make a reasonable call and explain it
* Self\-directed; you drive your own work to completion without close supervision
* Comfortable with a fast pace, evolving requirements and a two\-releases\-a\-month cadence
* Willing to work in\-office in Gurugram and overlap with US hours when needed


**Preferred**
* Formal design education — B.Des / M.Des in Interaction, Communication or Product Design, or HCI

title: Fraud & Risk Analyst
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Maya Mobile is one of the world's top 5 travel eSIM brands, trusted by 3\.5M\+ travelers across 190\+ countries to stay connected the moment they land. Our app makes it dead simple — pick your destination, tap to install, and you're online. No SIM swaps, no roaming bills, no hassle. Backed by our own mobile network infrastructure, we combine the reliability of a real carrier with the speed and simplicity travelers expect from a best\-in\-class consumer app. We're growing fast, scaling globally, and building the brand that travelers recommend to every friend before their next trip.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We're looking for a sharp, curious, and data\-driven Fraud \& Risk Analyst to join our team and help protect Maya Mobile's revenue and customer trust. This is a foundational role — you'll be at the center of identifying, investigating, and preventing fraud across our transaction ecosystem, including payment processing, promotional vouchers and coupon codes, eSIM activation abuse, and usage anomalies. You'll work with large datasets, build detection frameworks, leverage AI\-powered tools to spot patterns humans can't, and help shape the fraud prevention best practices that will scale with our business. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who is analytically rigorous, naturally skeptical, and excited about using modern tools — including AI and automation — to outsmart bad actors.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Fraud Detection \& Investigation**
* Monitor and investigate suspicious activity across payments, voucher redemptions, promotional code abuse, refund patterns, and eSIM activation/usage anomalies.
* Analyze transaction\-level data to identify fraud rings, synthetic identities, account takeover attempts, and policy exploitation.
* Investigate chargebacks and payment disputes, coordinating with payment processors (e.g., Adyen) and internal teams to resolve cases and recover revenue.
* 
* **Big Data Analysis \& AI\-Powered Detection**
* Work with large\-scale transaction and behavioral datasets to surface fraud signals and emerging attack vectors.
* Use AI and machine learning tools (e.g., anomaly detection models, LLM\-assisted pattern recognition, automated alerting) to improve detection speed and accuracy.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track fraud KPIs — loss rates, false positive rates, detection latency, and voucher/coupon abuse metrics.
* 
* **Best Practices \& Prevention Frameworks**
* Help develop and document fraud prevention best practices, standard operating procedures, and escalation workflows.
* Contribute to rule\-based and risk\-scoring frameworks for transaction approval, voucher issuance, and promotional campaign safeguards.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Payments, and Marketing to embed fraud controls into new features, campaigns, and partner integrations before launch.
* Conduct post\-incident reviews and recommend systemic improvements.
* 
* **Reporting \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Prepare clear, concise fraud reports and case summaries for leadership review.
* Partner with the payments and finance teams on chargeback management, BIN attack response, and payment processor risk tooling (e.g., Adyen RevenueProtect).
* Stay current on emerging fraud trends in digital payments, eSIM/telecom, and e\-commerce.


- 


  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong analytical skills with the ability to work comfortably with large datasets.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one data analysis tool or language (Python, R, Excel/Google Sheets at an advanced level).
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and enthusiasm for using AI\-powered tools (ChatGPT, Claude, custom models) to enhance fraud analysis workflows.
* Excellent attention to detail and a healthy sense of skepticism — you notice when numbers don't add up.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to document findings and present them clearly.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Prior internship or project experience in fraud, risk, payments, or compliance.
* Exposure to payment processing platforms (Adyen, Stripe, Braintree) or chargeback management tools.
* Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
* Familiarity with telecom, eSIM, or travel\-tech industries.
* Understanding of common fraud typologies: promo abuse, coupon stacking, card testing, friendly fraud, account farming.
* Experience building or working with rule engines, risk\-scoring systems, or anomaly detection pipelines.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Fully remote role — work from India or the Philippines.
* The opportunity to build fraud and risk infrastructure from the ground up at a high\-growth company.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and cross\-functional decision\-making.
* A fast\-paced, low\-bureaucracy culture where your work has immediate, measurable impact.
* Access to cutting\-edge AI and data tools to do your best work.



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Maya Mobile is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HR PROFESSIONAL

**Company:** Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Human Resources / Recruitment / Vendor Management  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Probation Period:** 2 Months  
**Work Mode During Probation:** Remote  
**Work Mode After Confirmation:** Hybrid  
**Compensation During Probation:** Incentive\-Based  
**Experience:** Freshers \& Experienced Candidates Can Apply

About the Role

Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for motivated, responsible, and performance\-oriented HR professionals to join our growing Human Resources team.

The selected candidate will receive exposure to multiple HR functions, including **Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Employee Management, Candidate Handling, HRMS, Performance Management, Training \& Development, HR Administration, Vendor Management, and HR Reporting**.

The candidate will initially join the **HR Department**, and the final designation/profile will be determined after successful completion of the probation period based on performance, skills, responsibilities handled, leadership potential, and organizational requirements.

Potential Profiles After Probation

Depending on performance and suitability, the final designation may include:

* HR Recruiter
* HR Executive
* Senior HR Executive
* Talent Acquisition Executive
* HR Operations Executive
* Vendor Management Executive
* HR Manager
* Other suitable HR\-related positions

Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment activities.
* Understand manpower requirements and job descriptions.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, social media, referrals, databases, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes according to job requirements.
* Conduct initial telephonic/video screening interviews.
* Evaluate candidate communication, experience, skills, availability, salary expectations, and suitability.
* Shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with candidates.
* Collect interview feedback and update candidate status.
* Coordinate with selected candidates until successful joining.
* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Work toward improving candidate joining and retention ratios.

2\. Candidate Handling

* Communicate job requirements clearly to candidates.
* Verify candidate interest and consent before profile submission.
* Explain job role, location, work mode, salary structure, interview process, and joining requirements accurately.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Follow up before and after interviews.
* Handle candidate queries professionally.
* Reduce interview no\-shows and joining dropouts.
* Maintain accurate candidate status and communication records.
* Avoid false commitments or unauthorized promises to candidates.

3\. HR Operations

* Support day\-to\-day HR operations.
* Maintain employee records and HR databases.
* Manage HR documentation and administrative processes.
* Coordinate internal HR activities.
* Prepare and maintain HR reports.
* Support implementation of company HR policies and procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.

4\. Employee Onboarding

* Coordinate pre\-joining and joining formalities.
* Collect and verify employee documents.
* Maintain employee onboarding records.
* Coordinate induction and orientation.
* Explain company policies, procedures, attendance rules, and work expectations.
* Support HRMS/account creation.
* Assist new employees during their initial employment period.

5\. Employee Management \& Relations

* Maintain professional relationships with employees.
* Address routine employee queries.
* Coordinate employee concerns and grievances with management.
* Support conflict resolution.
* Maintain proper documentation of employee\-related matters.
* Promote professional workplace communication and discipline.

6\. Attendance, Leave \& HRMS

* Monitor employee attendance and working status.
* Maintain attendance and leave records.
* Coordinate leave applications and approvals.
* Monitor late logins, early logouts, absenteeism, and attendance irregularities.
* Maintain accurate employee information in HRMS.
* Monitor login/logout and employee work status where applicable.
* Prepare attendance and leave reports for management.

7\. Performance Management

* Monitor employee performance during probation and employment.
* Track assigned tasks, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
* Maintain performance records.
* Identify performance gaps.
* Coordinate performance reviews.
* Support performance improvement initiatives.
* Provide accurate performance information to management for confirmation, extension, promotion, or other employment decisions.

8\. Training \& Development

* Identify employee training requirements.
* Coordinate employee induction and training programs.
* Maintain training attendance and records.
* Monitor participation in mandatory training.
* Collect training feedback.
* Support employee skill\-development initiatives.

9\. Vendor Management

* Identify potential recruitment and staffing vendors.
* Communicate with recruitment agencies and consultancy partners.
* Build and maintain professional vendor relationships.
* Share approved manpower requirements and job descriptions with vendors.
* Receive and review candidate profiles submitted by vendors.
* Check candidate quality, eligibility, and relevance.
* Coordinate vendor\-submitted candidate interviews.
* Follow up with vendors for candidate status and interview feedback.
* Track candidates from profile submission through joining.
* Maintain vendor databases and trackers.
* Monitor vendor performance and candidate quality.
* Coordinate pending requirements and recruitment closures.
* Support vendor onboarding and documentation.
* Support commercial discussions and negotiations when authorized by management.
* Ensure vendors follow approved company processes and commercial terms.
* Identify and develop new recruitment/vendor partnerships.
* Escalate vendor\-related issues to management.

10\. HR Documentation \& Administration

* Maintain employee files and records.
* Prepare or support preparation of HR letters and documents.
* Maintain joining, onboarding, probation, and performance records.
* Maintain disciplinary documentation where applicable.
* Ensure confidential documents are properly maintained.
* Support payroll\-related documentation and attendance inputs when authorized.

11\. HR Reporting \& MIS

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR reports.
* Maintain recruitment and candidate pipeline reports.
* Prepare employee attendance and status reports.
* Maintain joining and attrition records.
* Prepare vendor performance reports.
* Ensure HR data submitted to management is accurate and updated.

12\. Employee Engagement

* Support employee engagement initiatives.
* Coordinate internal meetings and HR activities.
* Support employee recognition programs.
* Collect employee feedback.
* Help maintain positive internal communication and workplace engagement.

13\. Exit Management

* Coordinate resignation and exit formalities.
* Maintain resignation and relieving records.
* Support exit interviews.
* Coordinate departmental clearance.
* Support Full \& Final documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee exit records.

Required Skills

Candidates should possess or be willing to develop:

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Recruitment and candidate\-handling ability.
* Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of Human Resources.
* Candidate sourcing and screening skills.
* Employee\-handling ability.
* Vendor\-management and negotiation skills.
* Documentation and reporting skills.
* HRMS and basic computer proficiency.
* MS Excel/Google Sheets knowledge.
* Time\-management and multitasking ability.
* Problem\-solving skills.
* Team coordination and leadership potential.
* Professionalism and confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Candidate Eligibility

* Graduate or pursuing graduation in HR, Management, Business Administration, or a relevant field.
* MBA/BBA/B.Com or HR\-related qualifications may be preferred but are not mandatory for all profiles.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to learn may apply.
* Experienced candidates with recruitment, HR operations, consultancy, staffing, or vendor\-management experience are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates should have access to a laptop/desktop and a stable internet connection for remote work.

Probation \& Final Designation

The initial probation period will be **2 months**.

During probation, candidates will be evaluated on:

* Recruitment performance
* Candidate sourcing and quality
* Candidate handling
* HR operations
* Employee management
* Vendor management
* Communication skills
* Attendance and discipline
* Documentation and reporting accuracy
* Task completion
* Problem\-solving ability
* Team coordination
* Leadership potential
* Professional conduct
* Overall contribution to the organization

Following successful completion of probation, **management will determine the candidate's final designation/profile based on demonstrated performance, capabilities, responsibilities handled, organizational requirements, and overall suitability.**

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is suitable for candidates who:

* Want to build a long\-term career in Human Resources.
* Are interested in both recruitment and core HR operations.
* Want practical exposure to employee and vendor management.
* Are comfortable communicating with candidates, employees, vendors, and management.
* Are disciplined, responsible, and performance\-oriented.

title: Transition Manager
description:
1\. JOB PURPOSE

The Transition Manager will be responsible for **end\-to\-end transition and mobilization of new Facility Management contracts**, from contract award until successful operational stabilization and handover to the Operations team.

The role will act as the **single point of accountability for transition**, coordinating with Sales, Operations, HR, Recruitment, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, QHSE, IT and client stakeholders to ensure projects go live **on time, within approved budget and with zero major service disruption**.

The candidate should have strong experience in **manpower mobilization, soft services, hard services, commercial planning, statutory compliance, vendor management, client handling and project implementation**.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Transition \& Mobilization

* Lead end\-to\-end transition of newly awarded FM / IFM contracts.
* Prepare detailed **30/60/90\-day transition and mobilization plans**.
* Conduct site surveys and understand client requirements, scope of work and operational expectations.
* Review contract, SLA, KPI, manpower deployment and commercial requirements before mobilization.
* Develop project\-wise mobilization schedules, milestones and responsibility matrices.
* Ensure timely readiness of manpower, supervisors, equipment, machinery, consumables, uniforms, PPE and other resources.
* Ensure smooth transition from incumbent service provider to the new FM service provider.
* Identify transition risks and develop contingency and mitigation plans.
* Ensure **zero critical operational disruption during go\-live**.

B. Manpower Planning \& Recruitment

* Prepare manpower deployment plans based on contract requirements and approved budgets.
* Coordinate with HR and Recruitment teams for timely hiring and onboarding.
* Plan local and outstation manpower mobilization wherever required.
* Ensure deployment of qualified supervisors, engineers and operational teams.
* Coordinate employee documentation, background verification, medical fitness, training and induction.
* Monitor manpower readiness against the project mobilization timeline.
* Ensure replacement plans are available for critical positions.

C. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary transition SPOC for the client.
* Conduct transition kick\-off meetings with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Establish regular transition review meetings and governance mechanisms.
* Understand client expectations and convert them into operational requirements.
* Manage client escalations during the mobilization phase.
* Coordinate with incumbent vendors / client representatives for smooth handover.
* Present transition progress, risks, issues and action plans to senior management.

D. Commercial \& Budget Management

* Review approved commercial proposals and transition budgets.
* Ensure mobilization activities are executed within the approved budget.
* Monitor manpower cost, equipment cost, consumables, uniforms, PPE and other startup expenses.
* Coordinate with Finance and Operations to ensure project profitability.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities without compromising service quality.
* Monitor deviations between **approved budget vs. actual transition cost**.
* Support Operations in understanding contract commercials, billing parameters and SLA requirements.
* Identify opportunities for additional services / upselling during transition.

E. Operations Readiness

* Ensure all operational SOPs, checklists, formats and escalation matrices are ready before go\-live.
* Establish site organization structure and reporting hierarchy.
* Ensure deployment of supervisors and key management personnel.
* Ensure equipment, machinery and consumables are available before commencement.
* Coordinate with Operations for service\-specific readiness.
* Establish daily, weekly and monthly reporting mechanisms.
* Conduct operational readiness audits before handover.

F. Soft Services

Experience / understanding in:

* Housekeeping
* Security
* Pantry / Food Services
* Pest Control
* Landscaping
* Waste Management
* Helpdesk / Front Office
* Support Services

Ensure manpower, SOPs, equipment, consumables and service standards are aligned with contractual requirements.

G. Hard Services / Technical Services

Should have good understanding of FM engineering services such as:

* Electrical
* HVAC
* DG / UPS
* Plumbing
* STP / WTP
* Fire \& Life Safety
* BMS
* Civil Maintenance
* Preventive \& Breakdown Maintenance
* AMC / Vendor Management

Technical engineering expertise is particularly relevant for senior FM transition roles handling integrated technical operations.

H. Compliance \& QHSE

* Ensure statutory and client compliance requirements are completed before go\-live.
* Coordinate with HR / Compliance teams for PF, ESI, labour law and other applicable requirements.
* Ensure safety documentation and risk assessments are completed.
* Ensure required licenses, certificates and statutory records are available.
* Coordinate QHSE audits and pre\-start inspections.
* Ensure 100% compliance with client and company safety standards.

I. Procurement \& Vendor Management

* Identify mobilization requirements and initiate procurement activities.
* Coordinate with Procurement for timely delivery of equipment, machinery and consumables.
* Finalize / onboard approved vendors as per company process.
* Monitor vendor delivery timelines and quality.
* Ensure AMC / service contracts are established wherever required.
* Maintain vendor performance and escalation records.

J. Technology \& MIS

* Drive implementation of CAFM / CMMS / HRMS / Helpdesk systems at new sites.
* Ensure employee and asset master data is created before go\-live.
* Implement attendance, payroll and workforce management processes.
* Establish dashboards and transition MIS.
* Track manpower, cost, SLA, compliance and mobilization status.
* Use **MS Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI / MIS tools** for management reporting.

K. Handover \& Stabilization

* Conduct final operational readiness review before go\-live.
* Prepare detailed handover checklist for Operations.
* Ensure all documents, asset details, manpower data, SOPs and vendor information are handed over.
* Conduct knowledge\-transfer sessions with the Operations team.
* Monitor the account during the initial **30–90 days stabilization period**.
* Track transition issues until closure.
* Conduct post\-transition review and identify lessons learned / process improvements.

3\. The ideal candidate should have strong communication, interpersonal, coordination, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage HR activities across multiple educational campuses.

* Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.

description:
##### **LOCATION**
**Mumbai/Pune**

##### **EXPERIENCE**
**0 \- 1 years**

##### **FUNCTIONAL AREA**
**Development**

**Role Overview**



As an AI Engineer, you’ll be part of a next\-generation engineering team building intelligent, autonomous systems that combine Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic reasoning frameworks. You’ll participate end\-to\-end — from data ingestion and model training to Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, and deployment of scalable microservices. This role demands curiosity, precision, and a passion for bridging traditional ML and modern LLM\-based agentic architectures into production\-grade systems.



Key Responsibilities


* Design and implement RAG pipelines for large\-scale data retrieval and contextual reasoning.


* Build, train, and fine\-tune ML models using Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch for structured and unstructured datasets.


* Develop modular AI microservices (FastAPI/Flask) integrated with vector databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Elasticsearch) and embedding pipelines.


* Orchestrate multi\-agent systems using LangGraph, LangChain, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) for dynamic task execution.


* Integrate and evaluate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic, etc.) for reasoning, generation, and workflow automation.


* Implement data and ML pipelines (Airflow, ZenML, Dagster) for training, evaluation, and inference.


* Develop and expose REST or WebSocket APIs for model and agent communication.


* Apply prompt engineering and reranking strategies to improve contextual accuracy and system reasoning.


* Work closely with data, backend, and AI engineers to deploy, scale, and monitor intelligent microservices in test/staging environments.


* Contribute to shared AI infrastructure modules, ensuring reproducibility, maintainability, and performance.


* Research and prototype new architectures, including multimodal RAG, structured reasoning, or fine\-tuning pipelines.



Required Technical Skills


* Strong understanding of RAG architecture — document chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and synthesis.


* Proficiency in Python, including libraries like Pandas, Numpy, and Scikit\-learn.


* Experience with FastAPI or Flask for microservice and API development.


* Hands\-on with LangGraph, LangChain, or MCP for multi\-agent orchestration.


* Familiarity with vector databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Elasticsearch).


* Good Working knowledge of ML/DL frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).


* Understanding of model serving via REST APIs, batch jobs, or pipelines.


* Exposure to containerization (Docker) and scalable architecture patterns.


* Familiarity with Git, MLflow, or DVC for versioning, tracking, and collaboration.


* Awareness of cloud AI/ML services (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI).


* Understanding of prompt evaluation, retrieval accuracy metrics, and contextual reasoning benchmarks.


**Secondary Skills**
--------------------


* Curiosity to explore Agentic AI frameworks and autonomous reasoning systems.


* Analytical mindset with a focus on debugging, optimization, and scalability.


* Strong communication and documentation skills for collaborative workflows.


* Innovative and research\-driven approach toward new AI architectures.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a motivated and enthusiastic CRM Executive (Fresher) to join our growing team and support CRM operations for our SaaS products and customer ecosystem.

This role is focused on managing customer information, monitoring customer interactions and product engagement, supporting customer onboarding and communication, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring a smooth customer journey throughout the customer lifecycle.

The ideal candidate should be detail\-oriented, analytical, good at communication, and comfortable working with data and multiple internal teams.

**What You'll Own**

**Customer \& CRM Data Management**

**Customer Lifecycle \& Engagement**

* Track customer interactions across different touchpoints and maintain proper records.
* Support customer engagement activities such as onboarding communication, reminders, updates, follow\-ups, and product\-related communication.
* Identify gaps in the customer journey and highlight them to the CRM Manager or relevant team.

**Product \& Customer Coordination**

* Maintain records of important customer communications and follow\-ups.

**Reporting \& Analysis**

* Prepare weekly and monthly reports related to customers, engagement, onboarding, retention, and CRM activities.
* Track key metrics such as:
* Customer onboarding status
* Customer engagement
* Product adoption
* Customer activity
* Follow\-up status
* Retention/churn indicators
* Campaign performance
* Customer response rates
* Assist in creating and maintaining CRM dashboards and management reports.
* Analyze customer data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Share relevant observations with the team based on customer and product data.
* Maintain accurate reporting and ensure data used for management decisions is reliable.

**CRM Operations \& Process Improvement**

* Support the CRM Manager in day\-to\-day CRM operations and customer lifecycle activities.
* Assist in defining and maintaining CRM processes, workflows, and data standards.
* Identify repetitive manual activities and suggest opportunities for process improvement or automation.
* Support implementation and testing of new CRM processes, campaigns, and workflows.
* Maintain proper documentation of CRM processes and operational activities.
* Ensure CRM\-related tasks are completed accurately and within defined timelines.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fresh graduate with a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, IT, Computer Science, or any related field.
* Basic understanding of CRM, customer lifecycle, customer engagement, and customer experience concepts.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English – mandatory.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint working knowledge – mandatory.
* Basic understanding of data management and reporting.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain data accuracy.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple internal teams.
* Comfortable working with customer and product\-related data.
* Self\-motivated, eager to learn, and open to feedback.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced SaaS environment.

**Good to Have:**

* Exposure to SaaS products or customer success operations.
* Internship or project experience in CRM, customer success, customer support, marketing, operations, or data management.
* Basic understanding of dashboards and reporting tools is an advantage.

**Key Skills: Good to Have**

CRM Operations \| Customer Lifecycle Management \| Customer Engagement \| Customer Data Management \| Data Hygiene \| Customer Onboarding \| Customer Communication \| Customer Segmentation \| Reporting \& Analytics \| Excel \| Cross\-functional Coordination \| SaaS Product Understanding \| Customer Retention \| Process Improvement

title: HR Recruitment Intern
description:
HR / RECRUITMENT INTERN

**Company:** V Support Solutions  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Internship Duration:** 2–3 Months  
**Department:** Human Resources / Talent Acquisition  
**Position Type:** Internship

About the Role

V Support Solutions is looking for an HR / Recruitment Intern to support end\-to\-end recruitment activities across multiple client requirements and industries.

The intern will receive practical exposure to candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate engagement, recruitment marketing, recruitment MIS and joining follow\-up.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand client job requirements and analyse job descriptions to identify the required qualification, experience, skills and candidate profile.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, professional networks, social media groups and other online channels.
* Search and identify suitable candidate profiles based on job requirements.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates against defined selection criteria.
* Conduct initial telephonic screening and assess candidate suitability.
* Communicate job details, responsibilities, location, salary range and other relevant information to candidates.
* Coordinate candidate interviews with clients and hiring teams.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the interview and selection process.
* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Track candidate status from sourcing through interview, selection and joining.
* Support candidate documentation and onboarding activities.
* Assist in preparing recruitment MIS and daily/weekly recruitment reports.
* Analyse recruitment activity and basic metrics such as sourcing volume, screening, interviews, selections and joining status.
* Assist in preparing and publishing attractive job advertisements.
* Support recruitment campaigns through LinkedIn, WhatsApp and other digital channels.
* Coordinate with internal team members regarding urgent and priority requirements.
* Maintain professional communication with candidates and client representatives.
* Conduct online research for talent mapping, competitor hiring and potential candidate sources.
* Support recruitment\-related content and employer/client promotional activities.

Skills Required

* Good Tamil and English communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and candidate\-handling skills.
* Confidence in making recruitment calls.
* Good internet and profile\-searching skills.
* Ability to understand and analyse job descriptions.
* Basic resume screening knowledge.
* Good follow\-up discipline.
* Basic Excel / Google Sheets knowledge.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously.
* Willingness to learn recruitment processes and work with targets.

Preferred Candidates

* MBA / PGDM – HR or Marketing
* MSW / HR specialization
* BBA / BBM / Any Degree with strong interest in HR and recruitment
* Final\-year students and fresh graduates may apply.

Learning Exposure

During the internship, candidates will gain practical exposure to:

* Talent acquisition
* End\-to\-end recruitment
* Candidate sourcing
* Resume screening
* Telephonic screening
* Interview coordination
* Candidate engagement
* Client coordination
* Job portal sourcing
* Recruitment MIS
* Talent mapping
* Recruitment marketing
* HR technology and ATS\-based workflows
* Professional communication

Performance Expectations

Interns will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and quantity of candidate sourcing
* Resume screening accuracy
* Communication skills
* Candidate follow\-up
* Interview coordination
* Recruitment database accuracy
* Timeliness and discipline
* Ability to understand job requirements
* Teamwork and learning ability

Ideal Candidate

A proactive student or fresher who wants hands\-on experience in recruitment and HR operations and is comfortable communicating with candidates, searching profiles online, analysing requirements and following up consistently.

Stipend

**Performance\-Based Stipend:** ₹5,000 – ₹25,000 per month, based on performance and internship contribution.

The stipend structure will be discussed during the selection process and will depend on the intern’s performance, productivity, and overall contribution during the internship.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

title: SAP Competence Center Manager
description:
Job Title: SAP Competence Center Manager


Job ID: R0095583


Location: India


Full/Part Time: Full


Regular/Temporary: Regular

  

At Dormer Pramet IT is positioned as a trusted technology partner and efficient service provider to the business. The **SAP Competence Center****Manager** holds a critical role in ensuring that both the functional and technical solutions within our ERP platform align with high\-level enterprise architecture and meet business requirements, facilitating smooth business operations.


About the role


This Managerial Role is part of IT Management Team.


As **SAP Competence Center****Manager**, you report to ITVP directly and work closely with BPO team, delivering insightful analysis and action\-focused technical solution. You lead strategic technical planning and processes. You conduct relevant and actionable analysis to support business growth.

  

Key responsibilities

* Oversee the management of the entire SAP ERP solution, ensuring synergy among platform products.
* Conduct product management in close collaboration with projects.
* Collaborate with stakeholders on designing relevant business solutions for Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, Production, HR, etc.
* Lead and mentor team members in assessing and estimating SAP ERP solutions for execution.
* Coach team members on utilizing SAP standard functions effectively and explore the system's potential for improving business operations.
* Lead and manage team members to deliver agreed\-upon solutions within SAP ERP.
* Act as an IT project manager for related areas as necessary.
* Manage vendor relationships and negotiations for project/change/service delivery within the SAP ERP domain.
* Maintain and monitor the system as a system owner to ensure its availability and efficiency.
* Communicate system performance effectively with stakeholders.
* Continuously improve the system to offer better solutions and services to the business.
* Develop and maintain financial forecasts and budget control for SAP ERP investments.
* Drive the decommissioning of legacy SAP ERP systems.
* Liaise with business stakeholders to understand requirements, prioritize features with a product mindset.
* Plan and manage releases of system products.
* Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration and communication for smooth operations.
* Ensure the system maintains a secure status.
* Conduct regular SAP audits to ensure compliance with internal guidelines and regulatory standards in SAP management and procedures.
  

About you

  

If you're excited to contribute and make a difference, we'd love to connect with you!

* Degree in a relevant field and previous experience as a IT SAP Competence Center Lead would be an advantage.
* Possess strong business acumen with a customer\-centric approach.
* 15\+ years of SAP ERP experience (R3, S/4 HANA) including implementation, maintenance, and support.
* Demonstrable product management experience.
* Familiarity with SAP products and pricing models.
* Knowledge of FICO/SD/MM/PP modules, SAP BPC, SAP IBP.
* Experience with RISE and SAP Commerce Cloud is advantageous.
* Proficient in agile methodologies.
* Fluent in English .
* Excellent communication skills.
* Certifications related to SAP are preferred.
  

What we do?

  

We are dedicated to making the world safer for everyone. Our team of almost 2,000 employees is committed to improving the manufacturing industry. We work together globally with one goal: to provide reliability to our partners and ensure our tools have a positive impact on both people and our communities.

  

What we offer?

  

By joining our team, you'll be part of a diverse and inclusive workforce spread across more than 20 countries around the world. At every stage of your career, you'll be supported by over a century of knowledge and expertise, with opportunities to grow and develop in whichever path you choose. By supporting you, we're helping to build a prosperous and sustainable industry for everyone.

  

How to apply?

  

Send your application no later than Sep.15, 2026\.

  

As we aim for a fair recruitment process, we utilize assessment tools to safeguard objectivity. When you apply for this job, you may receive an invitation via email to a personality and logic ability test. Feedback comes immediately after the test has been completed and the selection process begins after the application deadline.

  

Contact information

  

For further information about this position please contact:


Nancy Chen at Nancy.chen@dormerpramet.com

  

About the company

  

Dormer Pramet is a leading global supplier of metal cutting tools and related services, part of Sandvik Group. **The manufacturing industry has always been about working together.** We exist to protect that legacy, leading the way with a globally connected network of manufacturers, partners and suppliers to deliver certainty at every turn. We serve over 100 markets worldwide through our enhanced distribution network, ensuring greater reach and reliability. Whenever or wherever there’s a need for cutting tools, we’re there to deliver. For customers, and for the entire manufacturing community.

* Deliver timely, accurate, and insightful financial reporting to support strategic and operational decision\-making.
* Improve forecasting accuracy and provide clear visibility into financial risks and opportunities across business units.
* Drive effective Global Capability Centre (GCC) recharge processes, ensuring transparency and consistency across regions.

* Proven ability to support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and managing cross\-functional relationships across multiple regions.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, data analysis, and reporting tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain financial information to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred qualifications, skills \& competencies**

* Experience in a Global Capability Centre (GCC), shared services, or multinational corporate environment.
* Exposure to intercompany accounting, recharge mechanisms, and cross\-border financial operations.
* Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, NetSuite, or similar finance platforms.
* Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Experience driving process automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Project management experience and exposure to finance transformation programs.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting.
* Prepare and review P\&L, Balance Sheet, management reports, reconciliations, accruals, and journal entries.

 **WORK EXPERIENCE**

* 20\+ years (incl. 15\+ years in workforce management, forecasting, or capacity planning and 5\+ years leading multi\-business / multi\-site teams)

 **TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Enterprise hands\-on model design covering demand, workload, productivity, shrinkage, service levels, location, and skill mix
* Advanced forecasting and quantitative methods: time\-series, regression, causal drivers, seasonality,
* Multi\-horizon demand and capacity planning across portfolios; workforce strategy

* Executive presence and ability to influence business, finance, HR, and operations leaders using evidence

* Ability to lead change, standardize planning practices, and resolve competing priorities across businesses and locations
* Strong talent leadership — builds a high\-calibre WFM capability and succession pipeline

 **JOB OVERVIEW**


The Workforce Management Associate Director will set the workforce planning strategy, governance, and operating model across multiple businesses, sites, or geographies. This player\-coach role combines senior stakeholder leadership with hands\-on expertise in WFM models, forecasting, demand and capacity planning, advanced Excel, and quantitative techniques. The incumbent will establish a single planning methodology, challenge investment and hiring assumptions, and ensure workforce decisions are aligned to service, cost, growth, and transformation priorities.

 **CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and own the enterprise WFM strategy, methodology, governance, data standards, model controls, and planning calendar across multiple businesses or sites
* Personally review and, where required, build critical forecasting, demand, and capacity models; challenge assumptions, methodologies, forecast bias, and investment cases
* Integrate long\-range business outlook, budgets, transformation roadmaps, automation, location strategy, attrition, hiring, learning curves, and productivity into workforce scenarios
* Chair executive capacity reviews and present clear choices, risks, costs, and service implications to enable hiring, location, skill, vendor, and productivity decisions
* Establish performance measures for forecast accuracy, utilisation, occupancy, shrinkage, capacity adherence, productivity, and plan benefits; drive corrective action across owners
* Lead and develop the WFM organisation, strengthen quantitative and Excel capability, and partner with Finance, HR, Operations, and Technology to mature tools and planning automation

* Enterprise WFM Strategy
* Forecasting \& Capacity Governance
* Executive Decision Support

title: Global Employee Data Analyst
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.  



  

**The Global Employee Data Analyst** works closely with the HR Capability Center to safeguard the integrity of employee data in the Workday transactions, while owning high\-volume employee documentation and statutory compliance activities (EPFO and NPS).


The role processes new hire, job change, time off and absence transactions, and employee/manager direct access submissions, ensuring all data is actioned accurately and on time. It maintains foundational data such as supervisory organizations, cost center assignments and position titles, and completes weekly payroll reconciliation — reviewing audit reports, analyzing discrepancies and processing updates so the Workday\-to\-payroll feed remains correct.


In parallel, the role prepares employment verification and compliance documentation, coordinates with third\-party compliance vendors, and resolves Provident Fund (PF), Pension and NPS matters within statutory timelines. Success in this position requires exceptional attention to detail, the ability to manage high transaction volumes accurately, and working knowledge of HCM and statutory processes.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Workday Data Management \& Employee Records**

* Maintain and/or approve all data pertaining to employee records in Workday (transfers, personal information, title changes, etc.) entered in Workday through Manager or Employee Direct Access.
* Complete pending new hire transactions in Workday HCM once the candidate reaches Ready to Hire status in the ATS.
* Support execution of employee movement, employee status, time off and leave of absence, payroll, benefits, Performance Check\-ins and compensation processes through accurate, on\-time data maintenance.
* Maintain supervisory organizations, organization assignments, cost center assignments and position titles.
* Support the integrity of employee records and Workday data, assuring legal and regulatory compliance.
* Review integration kickout reports from various systems and process corresponding updates in Workday.
* Complete reports, documents and forms requiring HCM data, including People Doc processes.
* Reviewing audit reports, analyzing discrepancies and processing appropriate updates.
* Process employee reimbursement transactions: validate submitted documentation and request payment via payroll.

**Statutory Compliance – PF, Pension \& NPS**

* Handle employee queries relating to Provident Fund (PF) and Pension accounts, including cases requiring correction.
* Review PF passbooks and employee service history to identify discrepancies and evaluate the root cause of correction requests.
* Coordinate with employees and vendors to prepare addendum letters, correction letters and supporting documentation for PF/Pension corrections.
* Approve KYC updates and PF transfer requests on the EPFO/PF portal in line with compliance requirements, ensuring all corrections and transfers are processed within statutory timelines.
* Collect revised Form 11 submissions and route them to the next\-level team for action.
* Manage monthly NPS linking letters, NPS portal approvals and reporting requests in line with company policies, benefits and compliance requirements.

**Vendor Coordination**

* Act as the primary point of contact for third\-party compliance vendors.
* Review, validate and prepare vendor\-issued compliance letters for accuracy prior to issuance.
* Track vendor deliverables and ensure timely closure of compliance requests.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify, troubleshoot and escalate issues as appropriate, and make process recommendations to achieve operational excellence.
* Enhance content, FAQs and LWIs based on case resolution feedback, in collaboration with functional teams.
* Identify and report case or product trends to management and Senior WFA, working with HR functional teams to improve service to the workforce.
* Work collaboratively across the HR team for consistent execution of key HR processes across regions and functional areas.
* Collaborate with all functional teams so People Services collectively achieves TAT
* Participate ad\-hoc projects and other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in or equivalent qualification in HR (HR specialization preferred).
* Minimum 5 years working with HRIS/HCM systems; 5\+ years in HR administration, compliance or a related field preferred.
* Prior experience with PF / EPFO / NPS processes strongly preferred.

title: HR Manager
description:
Position
   

 HR Manager
   

  

 Reporting To
   

 Director / Head – Human Resources
   

 Location
   

 Nariman Point, Mumbai
   

 Employment Type
   

 Full\-Time
   

 Experience Required
   

 5–8\+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, preferably in the manufacturing industry.
   

 Educational Qualification
   

 • MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent.
   

 • Additional certifications in Labour Laws, Talent Management, HR Analytics, or Learning \& Development will be an advantage.
   

 About the Role
   

 The HR Manager will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle, ensuring that HR strategies, policies, and practices support the organization's business objectives. The role includes Talent Acquisition, Employee Engagement, Performance Management, Learning \& Development, HR Operations, Compliance, Payroll Coordination, Employee Relations, and Exit Management while maintaining a positive workplace culture.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

 1\. Workforce Planning \& Recruitment
   

 • Develop manpower plans in coordination with department heads.
   

 • Prepare and update Job Descriptions (JDs).
   

 • Manage recruitment for blue\-collar, white\-collar, and leadership positions.
   

 • Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, consultants, and campus hiring.
   

 • Screen resumes and conduct initial interviews.
   

 • Coordinate technical and management interviews.
   

 • Manage candidate communication throughout the hiring process.
   

 • Conduct salary negotiations and issue offer letters.
   

 • Maintain recruitment reports, hiring metrics, and recruitment dashboards.
   

 • Build employer branding initiatives.
   

 2\. Onboarding \& Induction
   

 • Ensure timely documentation before joining.
   

 • Coordinate pre\-joining formalities.
   

 • Conduct employee induction and orientation.
   

 • Introduce company policies, culture, and organizational structure.
   

 • Coordinate department\-wise onboarding.
   

 • Ensure smooth integration of new employees.
   

 3\. HR Operations
   

 • Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
   

 • Generate employment letters, confirmation letters, promotion letters, transfer letters, and experience certificates.
   

 • Maintain employee database and HRIS.
   

 • Monitor attendance and leave management.
   

 • Coordinate payroll inputs with Finance.
   

 • Ensure accurate employee documentation.
   

 4\. Performance Management
   

 • Design and implement performance appraisal systems.
   

 • Coordinate probation reviews and employee confirmations.
   

 • Monitor KPIs and KRAs.
   

 • Support managers during performance review discussions.
   

 • Identify high\-potential employees.
   

 • Develop Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) where required.
   

 5\. Learning \& Development
   

 • Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA).
   

 • Prepare annual training calendars.
   

 • Organize technical, behavioral, leadership, and compliance training programs.
   

 • Evaluate training effectiveness.
   

 • Track employee learning and certifications.
   

 • Develop succession planning initiatives.
   

 6\. Employee Engagement
   

 • Plan employee engagement activities and recognition programs.
   

 • Conduct employee satisfaction surveys.
   

 • Organize wellness initiatives, festivals, and team\-building events.
   

 • Promote a positive work culture.
   

 • Address employee concerns proactively.
   

 7\. Employee Relations
   

 • Handle employee grievances confidentially.
   

 • Counsel employees and managers on workplace issues.
   

 • Resolve conflicts through effective communication.
   

 • Promote fairness, diversity, and inclusion.
   

 • Support disciplinary processes where required.
   

 8\. Compensation \& Benefits
   

 • Coordinate payroll processing.
   

 • Review salary structures and benefits.
   

 • Manage annual increments and promotions.
   

 • Support compensation benchmarking.
   

 • Ensure statutory deductions are accurate.
   

 9\. HR Compliance \& Labour Laws
   

 • Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws.
   

 • Maintain statutory registers and records.
   

 • Coordinate compliance audits.
   

 • Liaise with government authorities when required.
   

 • Ensure timely filing of statutory returns.
   

 • Implement company HR policies and procedures.
   

 10\. HR Policies \& Process Improvement
   

 • Develop and update HR policies.
   

 • Improve HR processes through automation and digitalization.
   

 • Monitor HR KPIs.
   

 • Ensure policy awareness across the organization.
   

 • Drive continuous improvement initiatives.
   

 11\. HR Analytics \& Reporting
   

 • Prepare monthly HR MIS reports.
   

 • Analyze recruitment metrics and attrition trends.
   

 • Present HR dashboards to management.
   

 • Provide workforce planning insights.
   

 • Support data\-driven HR decision\-making.
   

 12\. Employee Separation \& Retirement
   

 • Manage resignations, retirements, and terminations.
   

 • Conduct exit interviews.
   

 • Coordinate full and final settlements.
   

 • Ensure return of company assets.
   

 • Issue relieving letters, experience certificates, and other exit documents.
   

 • Maintain employee separation records.
   

 • Analyze attrition data and recommend retention strategies.
   

  

 Preferred Industry
   

 Manufacturing, Engineering, Industrial Products, Technical Textiles, Infrastructure, or similar sectors.
   

  

 Why Join Us?
   

  

 • Opportunity to lead the complete HR function.
   

 • Exposure to strategic and operational HR responsibilities.
   

 • Collaborative work environment with opportunities for growth.
   

 • Chance to contribute to organizational development and employee success.
   

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

 • Talent Acquisition

 • Employee Lifecycle Management
   

 • Performance Management
   

 • Learning \& Development
   

 • Payroll Coordination
   

 • Labour Law Compliance

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
Senior Human Resources Manager
 
**Location:** 
 Thane, Maharashtra
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
 



**Company:** 
 Lunar Wave LLC
 


 About Lunar Wave LLC
 
 Lunar Wave LLC is a fast\-growing digital products and performance marketing company. We operate multiple consumer\-facing digital brands and are building a high\-performance team across creative strategy, media buying, design, video editing, technology and operations.
 



 As we grow, we're looking for an experienced
 **Senior Human Resources Manager** 
 who can take complete ownership of our people function and help us build a high\-performance, accountable and positive work culture.
 


 About the Role
 
 This is not a purely administrative HR position.
 



 We're looking for someone who can independently manage the entire employee lifecycle while acting as a strong bridge between employees, managers and leadership.
 



 You will be responsible for creating structure, improving communication, resolving employee concerns, strengthening managers, managing performance and ensuring that problems are identified and addressed before they escalate.
 



 You should be comfortable working directly with the Founder and leadership team and confident enough to give honest feedback when something needs to change.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Own end\-to\-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to interviews, offers and onboarding
* Build and maintain HR policies, SOPs and employee processes
* Manage attendance, leaves, payroll coordination, employee records and HR documentation
* Design and manage performance reviews, KPIs, feedback systems, PIPs and improvement plans
* Conduct regular employee 1\-on\-1s and identify recurring concerns or workplace issues
* Handle employee grievances professionally, confidentially and objectively
* Resolve conflicts between employees, managers and teams before they escalate
* Coach Team Leads and managers on communication, feedback and people management
* Build clear escalation and grievance\-resolution processes
* Improve employee engagement, communication and overall workplace culture
* Identify high performers, underperformers and potential retention risks
* Manage promotions, increments, warnings, disciplinary processes and exits
* Conduct structured onboarding and exit interviews
* Organize employee engagement activities and team initiatives
* Ensure compliance with applicable employment policies and requirements
* Provide leadership with regular insights into employee sentiment, performance and organizational issues
* Build HR systems that can support the company as the team continues to grow


 What We're Looking For
 * **5\+ years of HR experience** 
 , preferably in a startup, agency, e\-commerce, technology or other fast\-growing organization
* Previous experience independently managing an HR function or team
* Strong experience in
 **employee relations and conflict resolution**
* **Strong understanding of performance management and KPI\-driven organizations**
* **Experience handling difficult conversations, grievances and disciplinary situations**
* **Strong recruitment and talent acquisition capabilities**
* **Excellent communication and people\-management skills**
* **Ability to remain neutral and objective during employee conflicts**
* **Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, high\-accountability environment**
* **Strong judgment, discretion and confidentiality**
* **Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions**
* **Comfortable working directly with senior leadership and challenging decisions respectfully when necessary**


 The Person We'd Like to Hire
 
 We want someone who is
 **approachable enough that employees feel comfortable speaking openly, but strong enough to handle difficult situations objectively.** 




**You should be able to distinguish between a genuine employee concern, a management problem, a performance problem and unproductive workplace behaviour.** 




**Most importantly, we're looking for someone who believes that a great workplace can have both:** 




**Employee freedom and a positive environment, while maintaining high standards of performance and accountability.** 



 Why Join Lunar Wave?
 
 You'll have the opportunity to build and shape the HR function of a growing company rather than simply maintaining an existing system.
 



 You'll work closely with the Founder and leadership team and have significant ownership over hiring, performance management, employee experience and company culture.
 



**Work Location:** 
 Thane, Maharashtra
 



**Work Mode:** 
 100% On\-site

 Full\-time

Full\-Time

We are seeking an analytically driven Software Development Intern to engineer and maintain direct API integrations and automated sales pipelines. This role centers on architecting seamless data synchronization workflows between Apollo.io, Zoho CRM, and internal databases to eliminate manual data entry and streamline outbound and inbound sales operations.  


The position demands a solid understanding of core programming logic, structured data handling, and backend communication. Rather than generic UI design, your primary focus will be designing webhook listeners, mapping data schemas between distinct platforms, handling API rate limits, and implementing error\-handling pipelines to ensure zero data discrepancies across our business systems.  

**Responsibilities**  

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable REST API integrations connecting Apollo.io with Zoho CRM to facilitate automated lead capture, contact enrichment, and bidirectional pipeline synchronization.
* Build end\-to\-end automated workflows for lead assignment, deal stage progressions, task triggers, and sales notifications using custom scripts and platform webhooks.
* Write clean, modular, and maintainable scripts to parse, clean, transform, and map complex, multi\-nested JSON payloads between third\-party services and database schemas.
* Implement robust error\-handling mechanisms, including retry logic, data deduplication, and payload validation checkpoints to handle API rate limits and prevent data corruption.
* Conduct functional and integration testing using tools like Postman, validating endpoints, request headers, authentication handshakes, payload integrity, and error response codes.
* Write and execute structured queries to store, reconcile, and audit synchronized sales records across databases, ensuring strict schema integrity and data accuracy.
* Troubleshoot and resolve sync bottlenecks, payload mismatches, authentication token drops, and trigger failures across active integration pipelines.
* Document technical specifications, data mapping rules, endpoint configurations, and automation flowcharts to ensure clarity and ongoing maintainability.

### **Requirements**

* Completed or pursuing a bachelor's/diploma degree in computer science, Information Technology, MCA, or a related engineering stream.
* Strong algorithmic thinking and core programming logic, with proficiency in at least one scripting or backend language (Python or JavaScript / Node.js preferred).
* Solid understanding of RESTful architecture, HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), status codes, authentication protocols (API Keys, Bearer Tokens, OAuth 2\.0\), and Webhooks.
* Practical fluency in data handling, particularly with JSON parsing, data structures, schema mapping, and payload manipulation.
* Familiarity with, or a strong willingness to master, Zoho CRM (including Deluge scripting workflows) and Apollo.io API capabilities.
* Fundamental knowledge of databases, with the ability to write foundational SQL queries to fetch, update, and validate business records.
* Hands\-on exposure to development tools, specifically Git/GitHub for version control and Postman for API inspection and testing.
* Hands\-on experience developing academic, capstone, or personal software projects demonstrating core programming principles.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to articulate technical logic, document workflows, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving aptitude, high attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a genuine eagerness to learn modern integration tools.

title: Analyst - Data Science
description:
**About bluCognition** 




 bluCognition is an AI\-powered commercial credit intelligence company serving lenders and financial institutions. Our platform combines commercial credit data contributed by 150\+ lenders with AI\-driven analytics, banking data and fraud detection to help our clients make faster, better credit decisions. Our product suite includes bluSense, which converts bank statements into standardized, categorized transaction data with real\-time financial insights, and FraudLens, which detects document tampering and first\-party fraud. Alongside our data products, we run a managed services business supporting underwriting, fraud review, and KYC/KYB and sanctions screening operations for our clients, with teams across North America, Asia and Europe.
 



  





**About Role** 




 We are looking for an analytically curious, detail\-oriented professional with up to 4 years of experience in data science and credit risk, proficient in Python, SQL, and data analysis libraries, comfortable working with large datasets, with hands\-on exposure to credit risk or ML modelling concepts. You will work alongside experienced data scientists and risk professionals on ad\-hoc analyses, model validation, and bureau data exploration — including U.S. credit card portfolios — while building the skills to grow into more independent modelling responsibilities over time.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Perform ad\-hoc analysis on large\-scale data to extract actionable insights and support data\-driven decision making.
* Develop a strong understanding of the credit risk modelling lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, validation, and monitoring.
* Build foundational knowledge of machine learning techniques and their applications in credit risk, including classification, regression, and ensemble methods.
* Support validation of existing credit risk models and assist in developing or enhancing models under the guidance of senior team members.
* Extract, manipulate, and explore large datasets using Python (pandas and related data analysis libraries) and SQL to ensure data quality and integrity.
* Communicate analytical findings and model results clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership presentations.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Must\-Have: 2–4 years in data science or credit risk analytics; proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy) and SQL; foundational ML knowledge (logistic regression, decision trees, gradient boosting); strong communication skills.
* Strong Advantage: Exposure to credit bureau data or consumer lending data; academic/project experience with credit scoring or risk modelling.
* Tools (if applicable): Python (pandas, NumPy), SQL, Power BI, and AWS / cloud\-based data platforms.
